item.title: Musk gasta 366 millones de dólares para ayudar a republicanos a mantener control del Congreso
item.description: Elon Musk ha gastado unos 366 millones de dólares en las elecciones de mitad de mandato de Estados Unidos —276 millones solo desde julio— con el objetivo de ayudar a los republicanos a mantener el control del Congreso, pese al aumento de las posibilidades de que los demócratas recuperen el control de ambas cámaras.
item.dc:creator: Dawn Kopecki
item.content:encoded:
Elon Musk ha gastado unos 366 millones de dólares en las elecciones de mitad de mandato de Estados Unidos —276 millones solo desde julio— con el objetivo de ayudar a los republicanos a mantener el control del Congreso, pese al aumento de las posibilidades de que los demócratas recuperen el control de ambas cámaras. La generosidad de Musk, de la que ya informó antes The New York Times, convierte a la persona más rica del mundo en, probablemente, el mayor donante político individual de las campañas de este año, según los registros de financiación de campañas. Hay mucho en juego para Musk, ya que los demócratas de la Cámara de Representantes están pidiendo que se investiguen sus contratos con el Gobierno al frente de la empresa aeroespacial SpaceX (SPCX.O) , así como su labor liderando el Departamento de Eficiencia Gubernamental bajo la presidencia de Donald Trump. A continuación se ofrece un desglose de su gasto político, confirmado por un portavoz de su súper PAC (Comité de Acción Política, por sus siglas en inglés), America PAC. Musk ha gastado 366 millones de dólares en lo que va de este ciclo electoral, que comenzó el 1 de enero de 2025. De esa cantidad, Musk ha donado al menos 276 millones de dólares a grupos republicanos y a su propio súper PAC desde julio. De los 276 millones en donaciones del tercer trimestre: 158 millones se destinaron al Senate Leadership Fund, el súper PAC creado para ayudar a elegir a republicanos para el Senado y alineado con el líder de la mayoría en la Cámara alta, John Thune, de Dakota del Sur. 20 millones fueron transferidos al Congressional Leadership Fund, el súper PAC creado para los republicanos de la Cámara de Representantes y alineado con el presidente de la Cámara, Mike Johnson, de Luisiana. 76 millones se destinaron al Musk’s America PAC. 10 millones se destinaron al Lone Star Liberty PAC, que apoya la candidatura del fiscal general estatal republicano Ken Paxton al Senado en Texas, donde las últimas encuestas lo sitúan en un empate técnico con el demócrata James Talarico. Se destinaron 10 millones de dólares a la Asociación de Gobernadores Republicanos. Se destinaron 2 millones de dólares a la Asociación de Fiscales Generales Republicanos.

El America PAC está ayudando a candidatos republicanos en siete estados clave y en casi tres docenas de circunscripciones de la Cámara de Representantes. Las nuevas donaciones se harán públicas el jueves, cuando muchos súper PAC estén obligados a revelar sus gastos del tercer trimestre. Musk también ha donado más dinero a través de grupos que no revelan quiénes son sus donantes, según indicó The New York Times y confirmó un portavoz de America PAC. Musk gastó unos 290 millones de dólares durante el último ciclo electoral.

item.title: Likely unexploded ordnance kills teenager in northern Israel
item.description: A 14-year-old Israeli boy was killed and 24 people were injured when what was most likely an unexploded ordnance went off during a school hiking trip near the border with Lebanon, Israel's ambulance service said on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A 14-year-old Israeli boy was killed and 24 people were injured when what was most likely an unexploded ordnance went off during a school hiking trip near the border with Lebanon, Israel's ambulance service said on Monday. The area is littered with explosive devices from Israel's conflict with the Lebanese militia group [USN:L1N42A08R TEXT:"Hezbollah"]. Rockets and missiles aimed at Israel from southern Lebanon sometimes fail to explode on impact, which can create risks for civilians years in the future. Deputy Commissioner Meir Eliyahu, speaking at the scene, said that an unexploded device had most likely gone off after being picked up by one of the students. "There were penetrating injuries, most likely the result of shrapnel impact from which fragments injured the patients," said Efrat Ohana, a paramedic at the site. Some 22 boys, 2 seriously, and 2 adults were injured in the incident, the ambulance service said. The Israeli military said that the device was likely an unexploded cluster munition from Hezbollah. Daniel Levy, Israel's chief of police, said they would be reviewing whether to halt school trips in the area.

item.title: About 30% of US Gulf oil production shut in response to Isaias
item.description: US producers in the Gulf of Mexico shut in about 29.63% of the current daily oil production and 24.81% of the current daily natural gas production in response to Hurricane Isaias, according to the Marine Minerals Administration.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: US producers in the Gulf of Mexico shut in about 29.63% of the current daily oil production and 24.81% of the current daily natural gas production in response to Hurricane Isaias, according to the Marine Minerals Administration. MMA said that as of Monday at 11:00 a.m. CDT personnel have been evacuated from five production platforms, representing 1.35% of the 371 manned platforms in the Gulf of Mexico. In addition, workers have been evacuated from one non-dynamically positioned rig, equivalent to 9.09% of the 11 rigs of that type currently operating in the Gulf, the agency said.

item.title: ローマ教皇、肺の結節切除へ13日入院 20日まで行事中止
item.description:
Joshua McElwee
[バチカン市国 １２日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Joshua McElwee

[バチカン市国 １２日 ロイター] - ローマ教皇レオ１４世（７１）は、片方の肺に見つかった小さな結節を切除する手術のため、１３日に入院する。バチカンが明らかにした。１３日から２０日までの全ての公開行事を中止する。手術の日時は明らかにしなかった。回復には約１週間かかる見通し。

教皇は１２日も多忙な日程をこなし、午前中には予定通り７件の会合を行った。

肺の結節は局所に生じる小さな病変で、良性の場合もある。

ローマのウンベルト１世総合病院で胸部外科部長を務めるフェデリコ・ベヌート医師は、肺結節の切除手術は通常、体への負担が小さく、胸腔鏡と呼ばれる細いカメラ付きの管を使うこともあると説明。「合併症の発生率は極めて低い」と語った。

教皇はカトリック信徒にとって最高権威であり、病気の際の職務代行者はいない。教皇が職務を遂行できない場合も、バチカンの大規模な行政機構は通常通り業務を続け、教皇の承認が必要な決定は保留する。

item.title: Richardson withdrawn from World Championships, British Cycling says
item.description: British track cyclist Matthew Richardson has been withdrawn from this week's World Championships in Shanghai, British Cycling said on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: British track cyclist Matthew Richardson has been withdrawn from this week's World Championships in Shanghai, British Cycling said on Monday. Richardson, an Olympic medallist who switched allegiance from Australia to Britain after the Paris Games in 2024, had been earlier named in the British squad for the championships, which run from October 14-18. "British Cycling can confirm that Matt Richardson has been withdrawn from the Great Britain Cycling Team squad for the upcoming 2026 Tissot UCI Track Cycling World Championships in Shanghai, China," a spokesperson said in a statement provided to Reuters. The governing body did not give a reason for Richardson's withdrawal. The Times reported that Richardson had been removed from the team amid an investigation into "alleged discriminatory posts and behaviour". Reuters has not independently verified the allegations, and has contacted Rocket Sports, Richardson's management agency, for comment from the rider. Richardson was injured in a crash during the World Series keirin event in Japan and was ruled out from making his highly anticipated England debut at the Commonwealth Games in Glasgow in July. (This story has been corrected to say the championship is this week, not next week, in paragraph 1.)

item.title: Criadores da Disney constroem um mundo de bruxas original para o próximo filme "Hexed"
item.description: Para a diretora Fawn Veerasunthorn, o próximo filme de animação da Disney, "Hexed", é uma história de amor entre mãe e filha que vem acompanhada de uma série de obstáculos.
item.dc:creator: Danielle Broadway
item.content:encoded: Para a diretora Fawn Veerasunthorn, o próximo filme de animação da Disney, "Hexed", é uma história de amor entre mãe e filha que vem acompanhada de uma série de obstáculos. Ela disse à Reuters que o filme é sobre uma mãe e uma filha que reatam o relacionamento após anos de tensão. “Foi uma ruptura que aconteceu, e esperamos que eles voltem a se reconciliar. Então, estamos analisando a situação sob essa perspectiva”, acrescentou a artista de storyboard conhecida por seu trabalho em “Frozen” e “Moana”. "Hexed", que chega aos cinemas em 25 de novembro, tem direção de Veerasunthorn, Jason Hand e Josie Trinidad. A trama acompanha Billie Doe, uma adolescente dublada por Hailee Steinfeld, que descobre ter poderes mágicos que a levam ao reino sobrenatural de Hexe, o mundo das bruxas. Outros membros do elenco de dubladores incluem Rashida Jones como Alice Doe, a mãe cautelosa de Billie, Walton Goggins como Beef Roger Crummchuck, um gato verde de três olhos, e Jodie Foster como a vilã rainha das bruxas. Embora os cineastas tenham se inspirado em lendas de bruxas já existentes, eles criaram grande parte do mundo de Hexe do zero. “Em vez de nos basearmos em propriedades intelectuais já existentes, pensamos: vamos criar algo original”, disse Veerasunthorn, acrescentando que o filme tem uma abordagem original sobre como os personagens lançam feitiços. Essa ênfase na originalidade ia além da mitologia do filme. A produtora Yvett Merino afirmou que era importante que o filme se estabelecesse como uma propriedade intelectual totalmente nova. “Queremos que Billie se destaque. Que Alice se destaque. Queremos que o mundo de Hexe se destaque”, disse ela. “É difícil nesse sentido, porque estamos tentando apresentar alguém e fazer com que este filme seja notado”, acrescentou ela. Ainda assim, Merino disse estar confiante de que o público se identificará com Billie e sua jornada como uma jovem bruxa descobrindo seus poderes e como uma garota se reconectando com sua mãe.

item.title: UK launches public inquiry into killing of two Jewish men in synagogue attack
item.description: Britain's interior minister Shabana Mahmood on Monday announced a public inquiry into the deaths of two Jewish men who died during an attack at a synagogue in Manchester in October 2025.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Britain's interior minister Shabana Mahmood on Monday announced a public inquiry into the deaths of two Jewish men who died during an attack at a synagogue in Manchester in October 2025. Adrian Daulby and Melvin Cravitz were killed during the attack at the Heaton Park Hebrew Congregation Synagogue during Yom Kippur, the holiest day in the Jewish calendar. Jihad Al-Shamie, a 35-year-old British citizen of Syrian descent, told police he was [USN:L5N3VP15G TEXT:"acting for Islamic State"] before officers shot him dead. Mahmood told lawmakers that a public inquiry "will ensure that all evidence can be heard, including any sensitive national security material that could not otherwise be fully heard".

item.title: L'Iran est derrière le projet d'attaque contre la base de Fairford, dit Londres
item.description: Les ministères des Affaires étrangères du Royaume-Uni, des Etats-Unis, du Canada, de la France ou encore de l'Allemagne ont condamné lundi "l'usage d'attaques violentes de la part de l'Iran", après que la base aérienne britannique de Fairford a été la cible fin septembre d'un projet d'attaque terroriste présumé.
item.dc:creator: Michael Holden
item.content:encoded: Les ministères des Affaires étrangères du Royaume-Uni, des Etats-Unis, du Canada, de la France ou encore de l'Allemagne ont condamné lundi "l'usage d'attaques violentes de la part de l'Iran", après que la base aérienne britannique de Fairford a été la cible fin septembre d'un projet d'attaque terroriste présumé. Située à environ 145 kilomètres à l'ouest de Londres, la base de Fairford a été utilisée ces derniers mois par des bombardiers de l'armée américaine pour attaquer l'Iran. Les Etats-Unis ont retiré leurs bombardiers B-1 du site militaire, des responsables américains invoquant une possible attaque de drones impliquant l'Iran. "Toute tentative iranienne de menacer, réduire au silence, intimider, harceler, nuire ou contraindre quiconque sur nos territoires par l'intermédiaire de mandataires ou par tout autre moyen est inacceptable", indique le communiqué commun signé par près de 30 pays. "Le Royaume-Uni a également conclu que cet événement démontre la volonté du Corps des gardiens de la révolution islamique (CGRI) de projeter des activités hostiles au-delà de ses frontières à travers des réseaux et des proxies clandestins", Londres accuse depuis plusieurs années le régime iranien d'être impliqué dans des tentatives d'assassinats sur le sol britannique, ce que Téhéran dément. Le Premier ministre britannique Andy Burnham a déclaré lundi devant le Parlement que le projet d'attaque visant la base aérienne britannique avait "très probablement" été coordonné depuis l'Iran, mettant en cause lui aussi le CGRI. L'ambassadeur iranien, Seyed Ali Mousavi, a rejeté les accusations britanniques, soulignant que le régime iranien était disposé à coopérer avec les autorités britanniques, rapporte l'agence de presse iranienne IRNA. Le secrétaire d'Etat britannique aux Affaires étrangères, Ed Miliband, a convoqué l'ambassadeur iranien alors que son ministère a imposé des sanctions contre deux ressortissants iraniens, dont Ruhollah Bazghandi accusé d'être impliqué dans des activités menées par l'Iran contre le sol britannique.

item.title: LVMH-Ventes inférieures aux prévisions au T3 avec le recul de la division mode et maroquinerie
item.description: Le groupe de luxe français LVMH a fait état lundi d'une croissance organique de ses ventes inférieure aux attentes des analystes au troisième trimestre, la demande pour ses marques de mode et de maroquinerie s'étant détériorée en raison de la faiblesse du marché en Chine.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Le groupe de luxe français LVMH (LVMH.PA) a fait état lundi d'une croissance organique de ses ventes inférieure aux attentes des analystes au troisième trimestre, la demande pour ses marques de mode et de maroquinerie s'étant détériorée en raison de la faiblesse du marché en Chine. Détenteur de plus de 70 marques dont Louis Vuitton, Dior ou les champagnes Moët et Chandon, LVMH a fait état de ventes de 18,50 milliards d'euros sur le trimestre, en croissance organique de 1% par rapport à la même période en 2025. Elles s'avèrent légèrement inférieures aux attentes des analystes, qui anticipaient une augmentation de 1,32% d'après un consensus compilé par Visible Alpha. Les résultats financiers de LVMH risquent de déstabiliser davantage les investisseurs, alors que le secteur du luxe, enlisé depuis trois ans, pourrait avoir du mal à retrouver sa dynamique passée. LVMH a déclaré dans un communiqué que l'activité en Chine avait été affectée au troisième trimestre par un contexte "moins porteur", tandis que les Etats-Unis, l'Europe et le Japon connaissent toujours une "bonne croissance". La division mode et maroquinerie, qui génère près de la moitié des ventes du groupe, a enregistré un recul de 5% de ses ventes sur le trimestre, alors que les analystes tablaient sur une baisse de 1,8%. Les principaux groupes de luxe européens ont perdu environ 330 milliards d'euros de capitalisation boursière depuis le début de l’année. Le groupe LVMH a perdu environ 40% de sa valeur. Les ventes en Asie, dominées par la Chine, ont reculé de 5% par rapport à l'année précédente, tandis que celles aux Etats-Unis ont progressé de 5% au troisième trimestre. "Au troisième trimestre en particulier, l'Asie a souffert d'une forte détérioration de la confiance des consommateurs chinois, due à des facteurs macroéconomiques, ce qui a eu un impact tangible sur les dépenses discrétionnaires", a déclaré la directrice financière du groupe, Cécile Cabanis, aux analystes. La campagne fiscale menée par la Chine à l'encontre des particuliers fortunés, qui vient s’ajouter à une demande déjà faible dans le pays, est devenue le dernier casse-tête en date pour les marques de luxe, déjà aux prises avec la guerre en Iran et des signes de ralentissement des dépenses de consommation aux États-Unis. Les consommateurs chinois représentent environ un cinquième des achats de produits de luxe dans le monde et ont longtemps été le moteur de la croissance de ce secteur. La demande a toutefois fortement baissé depuis la pandémie de Covid-19.

item.title: Report: Tests confirm torn Achilles for Packers DT Javon Hargrave
item.description: Tests confirmed that Green Bay defensive tackle Javon Hargrave sustained a season-ending torn Achilles tendon on Sunday, ESPN reported on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Tests confirmed that Green Bay defensive tackle Javon Hargrave sustained a season-ending torn Achilles tendon on Sunday, ESPN reported on Monday. Packers coach Matt LaFleur anticipated the bad news after their 31-7 victory against the visiting Chicago Bears, saying the injury that occurred late in the fourth quarter "doesn't look good." Hargrave, 33, was injured while chasing Bears quarterback Case Keenum in the fourth quarter. He fell without contact and was eventually carted off the field with 1:53 remaining. Hargrave had one tackle and one quarterback hit before exiting. He has six stops in four games this season after signing with the Packers as a free agent in March. Hargrave has 438 tackles and 49 sacks in 150 regular-season games (130 starts) with the Pittsburgh Steelers (2016-19), Philadelphia Eagles (2020-22), San Francisco 49ers (2023-24), Minnesota Vikings (2025) and Packers. He earned Pro Bowl honors with the Eagles in 2021 and 49ers in 2023. --Field Level Media

item.title: Drugmaker Corcept seeks to bar ex-judge's views in Teva antitrust case
item.description: Drugmaker Corcept Therapeutics is seeking to exclude testimony from a retired federal appeals court judge supporting Teva Pharmaceuticals in an antitrust lawsuit, arguing her opinions could sway jurors without shedding light on the facts of the case.
item.dc:creator: Mike Scarcella
item.content:encoded: Drugmaker Corcept Therapeutics (CORT.O) is seeking to exclude testimony from a retired federal appeals court judge supporting Teva Pharmaceuticals (TEVA.TA) in an antitrust lawsuit, arguing her opinions could sway jurors without shedding light on the facts of the case. In a filing on Friday in federal court in California, Corcept said consultant and retired judge Kathleen O’Malley of the US Court of Appeals for the Federal Circuit offered no technical expertise and that her presentation of legal opinions was inappropriate. "Judge O’Malley’s usurpation of the jury is particularly harmful given her position as a former jurist," Corcept said. "It is likely that the jury will not understand she brings no technical expertise in any factual area in the case and give her testimony undue weight, even though her opinions are ultimately just how she thinks the jury should decide." Teva, Corcept and O’Malley did not immediately respond to requests for comment. Teva sued Corcept in 2024, [USN:L2N3V203F TEXT:"claiming"] it monopolized the market for the drug Korlym to treat the hormonal disorder Cushing's syndrome. The lawsuit said Teva suffered "substantial lost revenue" from its efforts to market a generic version of Korlym, and seeks unspecified monetary damages and a court order stopping Corcept's alleged anti-competitive conduct. Korlym's active ingredient is mifepristone, the same drug used for medication abortion. Corcept has denied the allegations. O’Malley submitted a report as an expert for Teva in the case that said Corcept had filed “sham” patent infringement cases. Teva's lawsuit alleges Corcept pursued bogus lawsuits to thwart competition from Teva's generic version of Korlym. O’Malley served on the Washington, DC-based Federal Circuit from 2010 to 2022. She [USN:L2N2WJ2LK TEXT:"later"] worked at law firms Irell and Sullivan & Cromwell before opening her own consulting business that includes appearing as an expert for companies in lawsuits. Corcept contends O'Malley's expert report offered potential jurors no help understanding the claims in the lawsuit, in the way a doctor might testify about the scope of a claimed invention. “Instead, Teva has hired a former federal judge to do the jury’s job for it,” Corcept’s lawyers at Quinn Emanuel said. The case is Teva Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. v. Corcept Therapeutics Inc. et al, US District Court, Northern District of California, No. 5:24-cv-03567-NW. For Teva: Devora Allon, Kevin Neylan Jr and Michael Shipley of Kirkland & Ellis For Corcept: Robert Stone, Adam Wolfson and Steig Olson of Quinn Emanuel Urquhart & Sullivan

item.title: DP World Tour set to ban all LIV 2.0 golfers
item.description: The DP World Tour will not offer memberships to players who join LIV Golf 2.0 for the 2027 season.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The DP World Tour will not offer memberships to players who join LIV Golf 2.0 for the 2027 season. DP World Tour CEO Guy Kinnings said on Monday that all LIV golfers will be barred from the European circuit in 2027. The decision would effectively prohibit LIV participants from competing for Europe at next year's Ryder Cup. "Players need to make a choice," Kinnings told BBC Sport. "We have rules and regulations which are there to protect our tour and which our members must all abide by. Players who are not willing to comply with our rules and regulations should not be seeking to join our tour." The news is a significant blow to LIV, which is desperate for player commitments after filing for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection in September. LIV, founded in 2021, is facing an uncertain future amid significant restructuring. The Saudi Public Investment Fund won't be bankrolling the venture following the 2026 season. Some golfers, including Jon Rahm and Tyrrell Hatton, were previously allowed to play on both the DP World Tour and in LIV events. Rahm's attorney said last week that the Spaniard will not be participating in LIV 2.0. --Field Level Media

item.title: Jets coach Aaron Glenn: 'Minkah (Fitzpatrick) is not a dirty player'
item.description: Jets coach Aaron Glenn reviewed the hit delivered by New York defensive back Minkah Fitzpatrick, a helmet-to-helmet blow that rocked Browns rookie wide receiver KC Concepcion on Sunday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Jets coach Aaron Glenn reviewed the hit delivered by New York defensive back Minkah Fitzpatrick, a helmet-to-helmet blow that rocked Browns rookie wide receiver KC Concepcion on Sunday. "Listen, I think Minkah initially tried to go with the shoulder and just like always, I mean, sometimes you say (the) offensive guy might put their head down. It's not like he tried to do it or the offensive guy tried," Glenn said. "It's just some of those things that happen in a bang-bang situation and they're tough to call. They really are. I do know this: Minkah's not a dirty player. He's never been a dirty player. And, listen, Concepcion, man, I'm glad to see him get up and be able to walk off the field like he did. But, no, I don't think Minkah is a dirty player at all." Fitzpatrick was flagged for a facemask defending Concepcion earlier in the first-quarter drive. He arrived as the ball approached and the impact sent Concepcion to the turf. His helmet hit the playing surface with full impact. Officials flagged Fitzpatrick again for the hit on a defenseless receiver. Concepcion posted to Instagram after the game to say he was OK. "Y'all know I'm good thanks to the lord and savior," he wrote. Browns head coach Todd Monken, who has coached several games against Fitzpatrick as an assistant coach, didn't see intent to injure on the play. "Minkah has been in this league for a long time," Monken said. "He's not a dirty player, I've never seen that out of him -- it's a bang-bang play, unfortunately it happened to our guy, and that's part of the league." --Field Level Media

item.title: Judges say ‘fit’ and ability outweigh politics in law clerk hiring
item.description: Despite a perception among US law students that politics plays a key role in judicial clerk hiring, judges themselves say political ideology is not a top factor, according to a new study on how judges pick their clerks.
item.dc:creator: Karen Sloan
item.content:encoded: Despite a perception among US law students that politics plays a key role in judicial clerk hiring, judges themselves say political ideology is not a top factor, according to a new study on how judges pick their clerks. Instead, judges say they seek to identify law students and recent law graduates who can meet their demands while getting along with everyone and ideally forming lifelong relationships. Judicial clerkships are highly sought-after one-year positions working under the mentorship of a judge, often helping to research and draft opinions. Clerkships can significantly boost a newly minted lawyer's pedigree, opening doors to prestigious jobs in law firms, law schools and government. According to the new study titled What Judges Want , based on interviews with 194 federal and state judges, clerkship hiring appears less like a “political animal at work” and more akin to “putting together a jazz quintet.” “The quintet needs players with skill, who can get along while being stuck in a small room, and who will come back for the reunions,” the study reads. The study by Vanderbilt law professor Tracey George, University of Virginia law professor Mitu Gulati and University of Toronto law professor Albert Yoon builds upon their previous work highlighting the [USN:L6N42O11J TEXT:"rise of judicial clerkship “stacking”"] — where law graduates complete two, three, or even four coveted clerkships with sitting judges before entering the legal workforce. That trend is concentrating clerkship opportunities among a small pool of candidates and shrinking the pool of clerkships available to others, they found. While many law students perceive politics to be a “key ingredient” in the clerkship hiring process, the professors wrote in their latest study, none of the interviewed judges said they would only hire clerks who are members of the conservative Federalist Society or the left-leaning American Constitution Society. Only 39% raised politics or ideology as factors in clerk hiring but none said they hire clerks expressly for shared politics. The judges said they rely heavily on recommendations from trusted law professors or other judges, with some reporting they cannot trust law school grades to identify who will be a good addition to their chambers. Experience and maturity were top factors. Many judges reported enjoying lifelong relationships with their former clerks, from officiating their weddings to meeting their children, who are referred to as “grand clerks,” according to the study. “In many cases, judges are choosing confidants for life,” it said. Read more: [USN:L6N42O11J TEXT:"Study finds law grads are 'stacking' judicial clerkships, curtailing opportunities for others"] [USN:L6N417117 TEXT:"These law schools sent the most grads to coveted clerkships in 2025"] [USN:L1N32R1ZA TEXT:"Federal judges want diverse clerks but struggle to hire them - study"]

item.title: UK to review high-profile figures' security arrangements after ex-minister's murder
item.description: Britain's interior minister Shabana Mahmood on Monday announced an urgent review of the security arrangements for high-profile public figures, in the wake of the killing of an ex-minister which prosecutors allege was ideologically motivated.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Britain's interior minister Shabana Mahmood on Monday announced an urgent review of the security arrangements for high-profile public figures, in the wake of the [USN:L8N45V158 TEXT:"killing of an ex-minister"] which prosecutors allege was ideologically motivated. Mahmood said the review would examine the current security provided to high-profile individuals, including royals, as well as ministers, lawmakers and other prominent politicians. "It is clear there is insufficient protection for those who serve," Mahmood told parliament. She also said dedicated police support will be expanded to leaders of political parties who are not lawmakers, former lawmakers and party spokespeople, "giving them access to a named police officer, as well as help with wider security measures". Mahmood's announcement follows the [USN:L8N43C158 TEXT:"killing in July"] of Ann Widdecombe, a junior Conservative minister in the mid-1990s and more recently a prominent figure in Nigel Farage's Reform UK party. Joshua Kerry had been charged with the murder of Widdecombe when he was subsequently accused of a [USN:L8N45T0UB TEXT:"terrorism offence"] targeting Farage and other unnamed public figures. Prosecutors allege Kerry attempted to gain entry to Farage's house in April 2025, with police watchdog the IOPC investigating the police's response. Widdecombe's killing, which stoked concerns about politicians' security, came after two serving British members of parliament were killed in 2016 and 2021.

item.title: Fed's Hammack backs restrictive policy, says better if it comes 'relatively quickly'
item.description: Cleveland Fed President Beth Hammack said on Monday the US central bank should move "relatively quickly" to a restrictive monetary policy stance in order to control inflation she feels has become more broad-based and is starting to influence firms' price-setting plans.
item.dc:creator: Howard Schneider
item.content:encoded: Cleveland Fed President Beth Hammack said on Monday the US central bank should move "relatively quickly" to a restrictive monetary policy stance in order to control [USN:L1N45M0L0 TEXT:"inflation"] she feels has become more broad-based and is starting to influence firms' price-setting plans. "I see inflation pressures as relatively broad-based rather than concentrated in one component. Energy has been making headlines this year, with prices rising for oil, retail gasoline, and diesel, but it isn't the whole story," Hammack said in remarks prepared for delivery to a National Association for Business Economics conference. Her remarks cited recent conversations in her district with firms planning to boost prices faster than their input costs are rising. "A restrictive monetary policy stance is appropriate to ensure a timely return to 2% inflation," Hammack said. "When feasible, I generally think it's preferable to make smaller adjustments, and to do so relatively quickly, rather than to wait and risk needing a larger course correction" if inflation becomes more persistent or inflation expectations start to rise. She said research by her staff puts underlying inflation currently in the mid-to-high 2% range, and "my baseline forecast is that it will take some time for inflation to return to 2%, even with appropriate monetary policy." "Demand-side pressures coming from the AI buildout are raising prices on key computer, electronic, and high-tech components. This is raising costs for data centers, yes, but also for projects that use similar components in aviation, electricity production, and construction," Hammack said. Current data does not point to "an economy in which the crew are exhausted and the boat is taking on water. It reads, instead, as one that can handle a tighter hand on the tiller to finish the job on inflation," Hammack added. Investors expect the Fed to keep its policy rate in the [USN:L6N4570XW TEXT:"3.75%-4.00% range"] at its October 27-28 meeting. Hammack, a voting member of the central bank's policy committee, has been among the more hawkish Fed voices, and dissented in favor of raising rates at the meeting in July. Her colleagues, including Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh, joined her in voting to raise rates in September. Hammack also said she felt it was important for policymakers to continue explaining their views, in particular providing their likely reaction to different economic data. Warsh has said he prefers a "quieter" Fed and is particularly opposed to forward guidance, or firm commitments to future policy decisions. Hammack said providing a "reaction function," however, was important so households and firms could understand how policymakers are processing new data and plan appropriately. "I have a responsibility to the public to explain why I make the decisions I make. Transparency has the benefit of allowing consumers, businesses, and financial markets to make better-informed decisions," she said.

item.title: Report: Eagles RB Will Shipley has torn plantar fascia
item.description: The Philadelphia Eagles' running back room took another hit Sunday with Will Shipley sustaining a foot injury that could sideline him for multiple weeks, ESPN reported Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Philadelphia Eagles' running back room took another hit Sunday with Will Shipley sustaining a foot injury that could sideline him for multiple weeks, ESPN reported Monday. Shipley suffered a partial tear of his plantar fascia during the first half of the 19-17 loss to the Jacksonville Jaguars in London, per the report. A fourth-round pick by Philadelphia in the 2024 NFL Draft, Shipley made just his second career start (first since 2024) on Sunday with starter Saquon Barkley (hamstring) out and backup Tank Bigsby (core muscle) on injured reserve. Barkley is considered week-to-week. Shipley, 24, scored his first NFL touchdown before exiting with the injury. His 2-yard run tied the score at 7-7 with 8:46 left in the second quarter. He finished with five carries for 6 yards and one catch for 7 yards. Dameon Pierce took over in the backfield after Shipley departed. Philadelphia finished with 22 rushing yards on 18 attempts, an average of 1.2 yards per carry. The Eagles (2-3) carry a three-game losing streak into Sunday's game against the visiting Carolina Panthers (2-2), who are coming off a bye week. In 36 career games, Shipley has rushed 64 times for 188 yards with one TD to go with 18 receptions for 122 yards. --Field Level Media

item.title: ULTIM'ORA-UCRAINA: Non è il momento di allentare pressione su Mosca - Kallas, Ue
item.description: Di seguito gli aggiornamenti sul conflitto in corso in Ucraina:
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Di seguito gli aggiornamenti sul conflitto in corso in Ucraina: 18.30 - I ministri degli Esteri dell'Unione europea sono ben consapevoli che questo non è il momento di allentare la pressione sulla Russia. Lo ha detto ai giornalisti Kaja Kallas, alta rappresentante dell'Ue per la Politica estera. "Per porre fine alla guerra il prima possibile servono pressioni su Mosca, non concessioni", ha affermato al termine di un incontro tra i ministri degli Esteri europei a Lussemburgo. 16.00 - Il presidente ucraino Volodymyr Zelensky ha affermato che è "sempre più chiaro" che la Russia non sia disposta ad accettare il cessate il fuoco sugli attacchi alle infrastrutture energetiche proposto dagli Stati Uniti, dato che Mosca ha colpito oggi sei impianti energetici ucraini. “Questo è ciò che accade quando la Russia intravede la prospettiva di maggiori entrate per la sua macchina da guerra”, ha scritto in un post su X. 14.45 - Il comandante in capo della Nato ha avvertito senza mezzi termini la Russia che le sue forze distruggerebbero “tutto e chiunque” fosse coinvolto in un eventuale attacco, qualora Mosca fosse “così sciocca” da sferrare un'aggressione sul territorio dell’Alleanza. Illustrando la sua "teoria della vittoria" in occasione di una conferenza sulla sicurezza a Varsavia, il generale dell’aeronautica militare statunitense Alexus Grynkewich ha detto che la Nato è un’alleanza difensiva, ma che bloccherebbe, neutralizzerebbe e respingerebbe qualsiasi attacco contro uno qualsiasi dei suoi membri per garantire che sia "completamente inutile". 13.10 - Il presidente russo Vladimir Putin sarebbe pronto a ordinare alle forze armate di non attaccare l’Ucraina durante la giornata dedicata delle elezioni presidenziali nel Paese. Lo riferisce l’agenzia di stampa russa Ria, che cita il portavoce del Cremlino Dmitry Peskov. 12.10 - Il Cremlino ha detto che sono in corso contatti riguardo a una possibile tregua energetica tra Russia e Ucraina, annunciata dal presidente degli Stati Uniti Donald Trump. Il portavoce del Cremlino Dmitry Peskov ha rifiutato di commentare se la tregua si applicherebbe solo alle raffinerie di petrolio e ha affermato che ulteriori informazioni saranno rese note a tempo debito. Il Cremlino ha però ha respinto l’idea di una tregua di 60 giorni, proposta dal presidente ucraino Volodymyr Zelensky per consentire a Kiev di tenere le elezioni presidenziali, affermando di volere invece un accordo di pace più ampio. 11.05 - La Russia ha violato la tregua energetica annunciata dal presidente degli Stati Uniti Donald Trump. Lo ha comunicato il leader ucraino Volodymyr Zelensky, esortando Washington a intervenire per garantire che Mosca rispetti i termini del presunto accordo. "Ci sono state violazioni da parte della Russia del cessate il fuoco energetico annunciato dal presidente Trump", ha detto Zelensky durante una conferenza sulla sicurezza a Varsavia, collegandosi in videoconferenza. "Stiamo aspettando i dettagli delle condizioni concordate tra americani e russi e siamo in attesa di vedere quale passo concreto gli americani siano disposti a compiere", ha detto Zelensky, aggiungendo di aver appreso dell’accordo dai media. "Questo cessate il fuoco energetico può funzionare e può diventare un passo importante verso la fine della guerra se gli americani intervengono davvero e si assicurano che i russi lo rispettino". 8.35 - Kaja Kallas, l'alta rappresentante dell'Ue per gli affari esteri, ha accolto l'annuncio di un cessate il fuoco nel settore energetico tra Russia e Ucraina, aggiungendo però che preferirebbe una tregua "che includa che le persone non vengano uccise". Kallas ha aggiunto che non è chiaro se la Russia rispetterà la tregua e ha invitato gli Stati Uniti a imporre sanzioni contro Mosca. 8.30 - Il presidente Usa Trump ha detto ieri che l'Ucraina e la Russia hanno raggiunto un "cessate il fuoco sull'energia" immediato, senza fornire altri dettagli. Del presunto accordo però non c'è conferma né da Kiev né da Mosca.

item.title: Lvmh, vendite trim3 sotto attese, cala divisione moda e pelletteria
item.description: Il colosso francese Lvmh ha registrato una crescita organica delle vendite nel terzo trimestre inferiore alle attese, a causa della debole domanda di prodotti di moda e pelletteria.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Il colosso francese Lvmh (LVMH.PA) ha registrato una crescita organica delle vendite nel terzo trimestre inferiore alle attese, a causa della debole domanda di prodotti di moda e pelletteria. Le vendite organiche, che escludono gli effetti valutari, sono aumentate dell’1% su base annua a 18,28 miliardi di euro, rispetto all’incremento dell’1,3% previsto dagli analisti nel consensus di Visible Alpha. La divisione moda e pelletteria, che comprende i marchi di punta Louis Vuitton e Dior e genera quasi la metà dei ricavi del gruppo, ha registrato un calo delle vendite organiche del 5%, contro una flessione attesa dell’1,8%. L’aggiornamento di Lvmh – il più grande gruppo del lusso al mondo e la prima grande azienda a pubblicare i risultati del terzo trimestre – sembra destinato a turbare ulteriormente gli investitori, tra i timori che il settore del lusso, del valore di 350 miliardi di dollari e alle prese con un rallentamento che dura ormai da tre anni, fatichi a ritrovare lo slancio di un tempo.

item.title: Sánchez dice que buques de guerra marroquíes entraron en aguas españolas durante la crisis de Ceuta
item.description: El presidente del Gobierno español, Pedro Sánchez, afirmó el lunes que buques de la Marina marroquí entraron sin autorización en aguas españolas frente a Ceuta tras la travesía masiva de inmigrantes a finales de julio hacia el enclave norteafricano, informaron varios medios nacionales.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El presidente del Gobierno español, Pedro Sánchez, afirmó el lunes que buques de la Marina marroquí entraron sin autorización en aguas españolas frente a Ceuta tras la travesía masiva de inmigrantes a finales de julio hacia el enclave norteafricano, informaron varios medios nacionales. No obstante, minimizó la importancia de los incidentes, calificándolos de aislados, y subrayó la importancia de las relaciones con Marruecos. A fines de julio, más de 72.000 inmigrantes cruzaron la frontera desde Marruecos hacia Ceuta, lo que desencadenó una crisis humanitaria y diplomática —que sigue parcialmente sin resolverse— y avivó las tensiones políticas en España, que se prepara para unas elecciones anticipadas el 29 de noviembre. El periódico El País informó el lunes, citando fuentes anónimas, de que, tras la avalancha fronteriza, al menos una fragata y varias lanchas patrulleras de la Marina Real de Marruecos navegaron por aguas territoriales españolas sin solicitar autorización. Según el diario, una fragata española tuvo que interceptar a los buques de guerra marroquíes para expulsarlos de las aguas españolas. En una conversación informal con periodistas en el marco de la Fiesta Nacional, Sánchez dijo que España y Marruecos son vecinos geográficos y que la situación fue difícil, aunque destacó que la comunicación entre las partes fue muy fluida y que no ha vuelto a pasar nada parecido, antes de señalar que los lazos con Marruecos son "muy importantes". Estas declaraciones se produjeron antes de la visita del rey Felipe y la reina Letizia a Ceuta, prevista para el martes y el miércoles, que podría agravar las tensiones entre España y Marruecos. Rabat reclama la soberanía sobre Ceuta y el otro enclave español, Melilla. El Gobierno no respondió a una solicitud de comentarios de Reuters. No fue posible contactar de inmediato con el Ministerio de Relaciones Exteriores marroquí para recabar sus comentarios.

item.title: 独労働相が辞任、義理の娘死去や年金改革巡る批判で メルツ政権打撃
item.description: ［ベルリン １２日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［ベルリン　１２日　ロイター］ - ドイツ中道左派・社会民主党（ＳＰＤ）共同党首のバス労働相は１２日、義理の娘の死去や自身に対する政治的攻撃の激化を理由に、両職を突然辞任した。地方選の敗北で痛手を受けているメルツ連立政権にとって、さらなる打撃となる。

バス氏は声明で「義理の娘の死を受けて、深い悲しみと向き合う時間が必要だと気付いた」と述べた。さらに連立パートナーであるキリスト教民主・社会同盟（ＣＤＵ・ＣＳＵ）の保守派議員などからの「公の攻撃」が増加していたとも指摘した。

後任の労働相には、西部ラインラント・プファルツ州の前首相、アレクサンダー・シュバイツァー氏が就く。共同党首の後任は明らかになっていない。バス氏は連邦議会議員にはとどまる意向を示した。ＳＰＤは年末の臨時党大会で執行部全体の改選を行う。

閣僚１人の辞任で政権全体が揺らぐとは見込まれていないものの、ドイツが直面する混乱が浮き彫りになった。

経済の先行き不透明感や生活費への不満を背景に、メルツ政権の支持率は低迷。９月に東部で行われた州議会選で極右政党「ドイツのための選択肢（ＡｆＤ）」が勝利して以降、メルツ連立政権への圧力が一段と強まっている。

バス氏が率いていた労働省はドイツの社会保障制度の大部分を所管する。メルツ氏の保守政党、キリスト教民主同盟（ＣＤＵ）の一部からは、バス氏が経済改革を妨げているとの批判が繰り返されていた。

ＳＰＤの共同党首であるクリングバイル副首相兼財務相は声明で「喪に服していたここ数日間の彼女に対する攻撃は不適切だった。受け入れられない」と述べた。財務省は、クリングバイル氏がこの日出発予定だったインド訪問を取りやめると発表した。

メルツ氏は、Ｘへの投稿で、バス氏の決断は尊重されるべきだと述べ、同氏の献身と緊密な協力に感謝の意を示した。

またメルツ氏は記者会見で、「われわれは変革への意欲を示したい。選挙結果を踏まえれば、それは不可欠だ」と述べた。新労働相となるシュバイツァー氏が懸案の法案を速やかに前進させ、政府内で円滑に協力すると確信しているとも語った。

連立を組む両勢力は、高齢化が進む中で年金制度を支える改革や、エネルギー価格の急上昇と中国との競争激化に直面する産業界を支援する改革が必要だとの認識では一致している。ただ、意見の隔たりはなお大きい。

item.title: Medicamento para enfermedades pulmonares de Bristol Myers da buenos resultados en ensayo avanzado
item.description: Bristol Myers Squibb anunció el lunes que una dosis más baja de su fármaco experimental ralentizó la progresión de una grave enfermedad que provoca cicatrices pulmonares, lo que lo sitúa en camino de convertirse en el primer tratamiento de este tipo si se aprueba.
item.dc:creator: Padmanabhan Ananthan
item.content:encoded: Bristol Myers Squibb (BMY.N) anunció el lunes que una dosis más baja de su fármaco experimental ralentizó la progresión de una grave enfermedad que provoca cicatrices pulmonares, lo que lo sitúa en camino de convertirse en el primer tratamiento de este tipo si se aprueba. El ensayo en fase avanzada contó con la participación de 1.255 pacientes con fibrosis pulmonar idiopática y evaluó dos dosis orales de admilparant, que actúa sobre una vía implicada en la formación de cicatrices pulmonares al bloquear el receptor de la proteína LPA1. Bristol Myers, con sede en Nueva Jersey, dijo que una dosis de 60 mg de admilparant, administrada dos veces al día, superó significativamente al placebo a la hora de preservar la función pulmonar tras 52 semanas. Sin embargo, la dosis más alta, de 120 mg, no alcanzó el objetivo principal del estudio. Los analistas afirmaron que habían moderado sus expectativas respecto a los resultados, alegando preocupaciones en materia de seguridad, y solicitaron datos completos para evaluar el potencial comercial del fármaco. No obstante, el analista de William Blair, Matt Phipps, señaló que el éxito de la dosis de 60 mg podría suponer una oportunidad de gran éxito comercial, con unas ventas estimadas de unos 1.300 millones de dólares en 2032. El admilparant se convertiría en el primer inhibidor de LPA1 para tratar la FPI si obtiene la autorización reglamentaria. Los tratamientos actuales para la FPI incluyen Ofev y Jascayd, de Boehringer Ingelheim, así como el fármaco antifibrótico de Roche (ROPC.S) , Esbriet. La fibrosis pulmonar idiopática es una enfermedad pulmonar progresiva que provoca una cicatrización irreversible que engrosa y endurece el tejido pulmonar, lo que deteriora gradualmente la respiración y la función pulmonar. Trung Huynh, de RBC, dijo que Bristol Myers se encuentra bien posicionada para lo que queda de año, aunque la atención de los inversionistas se centrará en los resultados de los ensayos de su fármaco para la fibrilación auricular, milvexian, y de su tratamiento para la psicosis relacionada con el Alzheimer, Cobenfy. La empresa también comunicó el lunes resultados positivos de los ensayos de su fármaco radiofarmacéutico contra el cáncer, RYZ101. Según la empresa, el admilparant se toleró bien en ambas dosis, con bajas tasas de abandono comparables a las del placebo. Se espera que a principios de 2027 se den a conocer los resultados de otro estudio en fase avanzada para el tratamiento de la fibrosis pulmonar progresiva.

item.title: Musk gastou US$366 mi para ajudar republicanos a manter controle do Congresso dos EUA
item.description: Elon Musk já gastou cerca de US$366 milhões nas eleições de meio de mandato de 2026, sendo US$276 milhões apenas desde julho, tentando ajudar os republicanos a manter o controle do Congresso, mesmo com a melhora das chances dos democratas de retomar a Câmara e o Senado dos Estados Unidos.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Elon Musk já gastou cerca de US$366 milhões nas eleições de meio de mandato de 2026, sendo US$276 milhões apenas desde julho, tentando ajudar os republicanos a manter o controle do Congresso, mesmo com a melhora das chances dos democratas de retomar a Câmara e o Senado dos Estados Unidos. A generosidade de Musk, noticiada anteriormente pelo New York Times, torna a pessoa mais rica do mundo provavelmente o maior doador político individual nas eleições deste ano, de acordo com os registros de financiamento de campanha. Há muito em jogo para Musk, com os democratas da Câmara pedindo investigações sobre seus contratos governamentais como presidente-executivo da empresa aeroespacial SpaceX (SPCX.O) , bem como seu trabalho à frente do Departamento de Eficiência Governamental durante a presidência de Donald Trump. Segue abaixo um detalhamento de seus gastos políticos, confirmado por um porta-voz de seu super PAC, o America PAC. Musk já gastou US$366 milhões neste ciclo eleitoral, que começou em 1º de janeiro de 2025. Desse total, Musk doou pelo menos US$276 milhões para grupos republicanos e seu próprio super PAC desde julho. Dos US$276 milhões em doações do terceiro trimestre: US$158 milhões foram para o Senate Leadership Fund, o super PAC criado para ajudar a eleger republicanos para o Senado, alinhado com o líder da maioria no Senado, John Thune, um republicano da Dakota do Sul; US$20 milhões foram para o Congressional Leadership Fund, o super PAC criado para republicanos da Câmara, alinhado com o presidente da Câmara, Mike Johnson, um republicano da Louisiana; US$76 milhões foram para o America PAC de Musk; US$10 milhões foram para o Lone Star Liberty PAC, que apoia a candidatura do procurador-geral republicano Ken Paxton ao Senado dos EUA no Texas, onde pesquisas recentes o mostram em empate técnico com o democrata James Talarico; US$10 milhões foram para a Associação de Governadores Republicanos; US$2 milhões foram para a Associação de Procuradores-Gerais Republicanos. O America PAC está ajudando candidatos republicanos em sete estados decisivos e em quase três dezenas de disputas para a Câmara dos Deputados dos EUA. As novas doações serão divulgadas publicamente quando muitos super PACs forem obrigados a divulgar seus gastos do terceiro trimestre na quinta-feira. Musk também doou mais dinheiro por meio de grupos que não divulgam seus doadores, de acordo com uma reportagem do New York Times e confirmado por um porta-voz do America PAC. Musk gastou aproximadamente US$ 290 milhões durante o último ciclo eleitoral. (Por Dawn Kopecki)

item.title: Details of UK PM Burnham's Manchester City meetings published
item.description: British Prime Minister Andy Burnham met Manchester City soccer club's chairman Khaldoon Al Mubarak at an investment summit in 2021 in his capacity as the then-mayor of the city, the Greater Manchester Combined Authority said in a statement on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: British Prime Minister Andy Burnham met Manchester City soccer club's chairman Khaldoon Al Mubarak at an investment summit in 2021 in his capacity as the then-mayor of the city, the Greater Manchester Combined Authority said in a statement on Monday. The statement came after criticism of Burnham's [USN:L8N45M1X9 TEXT:"initial response"] to a ruling that found the club guilty of serious breaches of the Premier League's financial rules. At that time he expressed concern that City's owners could sell the club after the guilty verdict, telling the BBC they had been "a huge partner in the building of modern Manchester" and in turning the club into a global force. Burnham's spokesperson later said the club should face the [USN:L6N45N12H TEXT:""appropriate consequences""] if wrongdoing was established. Nevertheless, Burnham drew [USN:L8N45O1GS TEXT:"criticism"] from opposition politicians, including the Liberal Democrat party, which interpreted his remarks as defending the club's conduct, and led to demands for details on his dealings with club officials. Burnham served as Greater Manchester Mayor from May 2017 to June 2026. The GMCA statement said: "In October 2021 Andy Burnham, in his role as Mayor of Greater Manchester, had a formal meeting with Khaldoon Al Mubarak at the UK Government’s Global Investment Summit arranged by the Department for International Trade." It added that he also met the chairman informally while attending a testimonial game in 2019 in his capacity as mayor. Manchester City staff had also supported visits the mayor had taken to China and Japan with business delegations.

item.description: Authorities rescued 321 people, including 12 foreigners, after a landslide blocked the Budhi Gandaki River.

KATHMANDU: More than 100 foreign trekkers are stranded at different locations after the flood ing of a river in central Nepal at the weekend swept away hiking trails and bridges, an official said on Monday (Oct 12). Authorities rescued 3 21 people, including 1 2 foreign ers, on Monday after a pre-dawn landslide at the weekend in Gorkha district, about 100 km (62 miles) west of Kathmandu, blocked the Budhi Gandaki River, leading to downstream flood ing. The army said the rescue operation would continue on Tuesday, even as the water level in the river had receded. The river is a tributary of the Trishuli River, downstream from another tributary where a glacier collapse caused a catastrophic flood in August that killed 1,457 people, with thousands still missing. There were no reports of fatalities in the flood , but five villagers were out of contact after black muddy sludge and debris washed away homes and damaged infrastructure, including three hydroelectric plants, national disaster authorities said.

Bhuwan Raj Ojha, an official of the Manaslu Conservation Area Project that includes a popular trekking route, said there were more than 100 foreign trekkers stranded in different areas who could not return because part of the trail had been swept away. "Those hikers who want to return because of the flood need to be rescued. Those who want to continue their trekking can do so from locations that are safe," Ojha told Reuters from Gorkha. "There are restaurants and tea houses along the route. They are safe."

Related:

Nepal faces long road to recovery as vulnerable communities bear brunt of disaster, say aid groups

Nepal: The Flood’s Wake - “This is my duty. These are my people”

The International Centre for Integrated Mountain Development said the latest flood may have been triggered by the failure of a temporary river blockage created by a landslide, according to preliminary accounts from Nepal 's authorities reviewed by ICIMOD. "This event is another reminder of how exposed mountain communities and river corridors remain to sudden, cascading hazards," Pema Gyamtsho, director general of ICIMOD, said. "While response efforts must remain the immediate priority, understanding what triggered this flood will be critical for reducing future risks and strengthening resilience."
