item.title: Arsenal suffer unprecedented double injury setback, says Arteta
item.description: Arsenal manager Mikel Arteta said he had never known a similar situation in his seven years at the club after Piero Hincapie and Martin Zubimendi were injured in a post-match training session after their Premier League win over Leeds United.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Arsenal manager Mikel Arteta said he had never known a similar situation in his seven years at the club after Piero Hincapie and Martin Zubimendi were injured in a post-match training session after their Premier League win over Leeds United. Hincapie, 24, came on in the 82nd minute as Arsenal won 2-1 against Leeds on Saturday, while Zubimendi, 27, was an unused substitute. Both players are now doubts for Arsenal's Champions League clash against Lille on Tuesday. "It's never happened in seven years I've been here. It could happen in the training session the next day," Arteta told reporters on Monday. "It's happened now and hopefully it doesn't happen again, but what can you do?" The Spaniard said the pair were injured during an additional session arranged for players who did not get enough minutes against Leeds. "We had a training session planned after the match for everyone that didn't get enough minutes, and in two unfortunate actions we lost two players," he said. "They'll have further scans to see where they are and we'll have that time frame for how long they are going to be out for." Arteta said the extra work was necessary to ensure squad players were ready when called upon. "If they never train, they don't get injured. The consequence of that is when you ask them to play they have no rhythm and no impact in the game," he said. Hincapie has made three Premier League appearances off the bench this season but started Arsenal's Champions League win over Napoli last month. Zubimendi has also largely featured as a substitute, making five league appearances from the bench this campaign.

item.title: Juíza critica Departamento de Justiça de Trump por remoção de árvores de campo de golfe
item.description: Uma juíza dos Estados Unidos afirmou nesta segunda-feira que estava “furiosa” com os advogados do Departamento de Justiça do país por causa de sua conduta em uma ação judicial que visa impedir a aquisição, pelo governo de Donald Trump, de um campo de golfe histórico em Washington.
item.dc:creator: Jan Wolfe
item.content:encoded: Uma juíza dos Estados Unidos afirmou nesta segunda-feira que estava “furiosa” com os advogados do Departamento de Justiça do país por causa de sua conduta em uma ação judicial que visa impedir a aquisição, pelo governo de Donald Trump, de um campo de golfe histórico em Washington. Segundo a juíza, a remoção de centenas de árvores do campo no final de semana "é indesculpável". “Mais do que estar chateada e furiosa neste momento, estou profundamente decepcionada com o governo”, disse a juíza federal Ana Reyes, de Washington, aos advogados do governo durante uma audiência no tribunal. “Em que universo alguém do seu escritório achou que isso seria aceitável?” Reyes afirmou que a remoção repentina de cerca de 500 árvores no East Potomac Golf Links, que começou na tarde de sexta-feira, era inaceitável porque, em maio, ela havia exigido que o governo notificasse com antecedência qualquer obra de construção de grande porte no campo de golfe. O fato de o Departamento de Justiça não ter notificado o grupo de preservacionistas que entrou com a ação judicial sobre o trabalho de remoção das árvores “custou ao governo toda a sua credibilidade” no caso, afirmou a juíza. A advogada do Departamento de Justiça, Marissa Piropato, disse durante a audiência que os advogados do governo haviam feito o possível para reunir detalhes sobre a remoção das árvores, a fim de poderem apresentá-los em um documento judicial. “Vocês não fizeram o possível”, respondeu Reyes. “Vocês fizeram o pior possível.” Desde que assumiu o cargo em janeiro de 2025, Trump tem como alvo instituições culturais e históricas do país, de museus e monumentos a parques nacionais e centros de artes, na tentativa de reformulá-las. O presidente anunciou no ano passado planos para reformar o East Potomac Golf Links, um campo de golfe público centenário de propriedade do governo federal e administrado pelo Serviço Nacional de Parques, órgão do Departamento do Interior. Trump, um jogador de golfe assíduo que possui vários campos, afirmou que espera que a reforma permita que o campo sedie grandes torneios. A Liga de Preservação de Washington, D.C. afirmou, em uma ação judicial movida em fevereiro de 2026, que Trump estava desrespeitando as leis ambientais para “destruir irreparavelmente um pedaço inestimável da história americana”, a fim de “transformar um espaço público de lazer em um campo de golfe exclusivo e de alto padrão”. Reyes disse aos advogados do governo Trump, em uma audiência em maio, que haveria “graves consequências” caso obras de grande porte fossem iniciadas sem notificação prévia ao tribunal. Em um documento judicial de 9 de outubro, o governo Trump solicitou a Reyes que indeferisse o processo, alegando que era prematuro, pois o “projeto proposto ainda se encontra em um estágio inicial e conceitual”. Os advogados da DC Preservation League solicitaram à juíza Reyes, no domingo, que emitisse uma ordem de emergência impedindo novas remoções de árvores no campo de golfe e exigindo notificação sobre quaisquer outras modificações irreparáveis, alegando que, apesar de suas declarações de maio, mais de 500 árvores foram removidas no sábado. Reyes emitiu uma ordem temporária no domingo que suspendeu qualquer remoção de árvores até a manhã de terça-feira e indicou, durante a audiência desta segunda-feira, que pretende prorrogar a suspensão por mais tempo. Kevin Griess, funcionário do Serviço Nacional de Parques, afirmou na audiência desta segunda-feira que a remoção de árvores tem como objetivo melhorar a segurança no parque e restaurar seu projeto original, e faz parte de um plano de 2019 anterior às ambições de Trump para o campo de golfe.

item.title: Papa León XIV cancela todos los actos hasta el 20 de octubre debido a operación de pulmón programada
item.description: El papa León XIV ha cancelado todos los actos públicos que tenía programados hasta el 20 de octubre, informó el lunes el Vaticano, antes de su ingreso en el hospital para extirpar un pequeño nódulo detectado en uno de sus pulmones.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El papa León XIV ha cancelado todos los actos públicos que tenía programados hasta el 20 de octubre, informó el lunes el Vaticano, antes de su ingreso en el hospital para extirpar un pequeño nódulo detectado en uno de sus pulmones. León XIV, de 71 años, dijo el que "recientemente, durante una revisión, los médicos me han detectado un nódulo localizado en el pulmón. Se ha detectado todavía en una fase muy temprana y está bien localizado". Se espera que el papa ingrese en el hospital Gemelli de Roma a el martes, informó la oficina de prensa del Vaticano a primera hora del lunes. No se especificó cuándo tendría lugar la operación propiamente dicha.

item.title: Michael Jordan’s Game 2 ‘98 Finals jersey sells for record $14 million
item.description: The jersey Michael Jordan wore during Game 2 of the "Last Dance" 1998 NBA Finals has sold for a record $14 million.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The jersey Michael Jordan wore during Game 2 of the "Last Dance" 1998 NBA Finals has sold for a record $14 million. Hunt Auctions announced on Monday that the game-worn, autographed Chicago Bulls jersey was purchased by Miami real estate investor Ron Firman in a private sale. It's the highest price ever paid for a piece of basketball memorabilia, and according to the auction house, the newly sold Jordan jersey ranks as the second-largest sale in history among game-worn sports jerseys. The New York Yankees jersey worn by Babe Ruth in Game 3 of the 1932 World Series -- during which Ruth called his shot ahead of a home run -- went for $24.12 million in 2024. Jordan and the Bulls defeated the Utah Jazz in six games to win the 1998 championship, the sixth and final title of his career in Chicago. Game 2, played on June 5, 1998, in Salt Lake City, saw Chicago even the series 1-1 in large part due to a dominant performance from its superstar guard. Jordan put up 37 points, five rebounds, and three assists in a 93-88 victory. He would go on to collect his sixth and final Finals MVP award, two more than anyone else in NBA history, nine days later. The wildly popular "Last Dance" documentary, released in 2020, was centered around that 1997-98 Bulls season. "The record-setting price achieved for the related Michael Jordan jersey is yet another corroborative result as to the significance of Jordan within the industry and popular culture. This remarkable garment bore witness to one of Jordan's most hallowed NBA Finals appearances as part of his 'Last Dance' season to complete his illustrious career," David Hunt, president of Hunt Auctions, said in a statement. "While Michael Jordan's importance within the sports memorabilia marketplace has long been established, it has now escalated to an elite asset class more typically reserved for iconic works of art. We are very pleased to have been able to facilitate this historic sale which serves as another benchmark for our industry." The previous record for a basketball memorabilia item was $12.26 million for the home jersey worn by Jordan in Game 3 of the 1998 Finals, which was sold via auction in September. --Field Level Media

item.title: Xpeng executive says EV maker will expand European production ahead of local content rules
item.description: Chinese EV maker Xpeng plans to expand its European production in order to comply with new European Union rules mandating minimum local content in electric cars, company vice president Yeqing Zheng told Reuters at the Paris car show.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Chinese EV maker Xpeng (9868.HK) plans to expand its European production in order to comply with new European Union rules mandating minimum local content in electric cars, company vice president Yeqing Zheng told Reuters at the Paris car show. Magna currently produces EVs under contract for Xpeng at a factory in Austria. Zheng said the volume at that factory "is not even sufficient" for Xpeng's needs as the company expects to continue growing by "high double digits" in Europe. The executive told Reuters that the additional production would be in partnership with a local manufacturer either to build a new plant or operate an existing one. The new production line would focus on building “mid-level” vehicles and would need to have a lower cost base than the factory in Austria. Zheng said the new assembly line should start production by the time the European Union’s ‘made in Europe’ rules take effect. The Xpeng executive told Reuters that a decision on a new production line will be made within months. The Chinese EV maker is currently working on building out a local supply chain to support more production and it will be "challenging" to find a battery supplier that can meet Xpeng's charging needs and produce cells with the right energy density.

item.title: Hackers aquecem geladeiras de supermercado na França, provocando incêndios e perdas de alimentos
item.description: Hackers elevaram a temperatura de muitos refrigeradores de supermercados franceses para 50 graus Celsius durante a noite, causando incêndios e perdas de alimentos em centenas de lojas em todo o país, em um grande ataque cibernético.
item.dc:creator: Leo Marchandon, Gabriel Stargardter
item.content:encoded: Hackers elevaram a temperatura de muitos refrigeradores de supermercados franceses para 50 graus Celsius durante a noite, causando incêndios e perdas de alimentos em centenas de lojas em todo o país, em um grande ataque cibernético. A Procuradoria de Paris afirmou que um ataque de "grande escala" estava "afetando refrigeradores conectados em diversas grandes redes de supermercados na França" e relatou danos como "perda de alimentos e incêndios". Entretanto, o primeiro-ministro Sébastien Lecornu instruiu a Agência Nacional de Segurança Cibernética da França (ANSSI) a investigar o caso, segundo uma fonte de seu gabinete. Eles disseram que a França "estava coordenando ações com seus homólogos europeus, já que outros países também podem ser afetados", enquanto investigava se outras empresas francesas corriam risco. O Carrefour (CARR.PA) afirmou que 80 de seus supermercados foram afetados, enquanto a Monoprix disse que 5% de suas lojas sofreram impactos. A Les Mousquetaires, proprietária da rede varejista Intermarché, informou que os refrigeradores de cerca de 150 de suas lojas foram aquecidos a 50 graus Celsius durante seis horas na noite anterior. Todos os alimentos foram descartados para evitar riscos sanitários, afirmou um porta-voz. O presidente-executivo da Cooperativa U, Dominique Schelcher, disse que seu supermercado também foi vítima. "Atacar equipamentos essenciais para a conservação de produtos frescos e para o abastecimento alimentar do povo francês é de extrema gravidade e não tem precedentes", escreveu ele no X. E. Leclerc e Auchan não responderam aos pedidos de comentários. Não havia uma estimativa imediata da dimensão das perdas do setor. "O comércio de varejo e atacado desempenha um papel essencial no abastecimento da Europa com os bens de que as pessoas dependem diariamente", afirmou Christel Delberghe, diretora-geral da Eurocommerce, associação europeia do varejo. " Este incidente destaca a importância da resiliência em toda a cadeia de abastecimento." QUESTÃO DE SEGURANÇA HOLANDESA A operadora holandesa de supermercados Ahold Delhaize, que administra a maior rede de supermercados da Holanda, a Albert Heijn, e tem operações significativas nos Estados Unidos, afirmou que também estava lidando com um "problema de segurança" em sua rede e que havia desativado vários sistemas para protegê-los. Um aplicativo para smartphones da varejista informou aos clientes que, devido a um "incidente de segurança cibernética", não era possível entregar as compras. Os pedidos online representam cerca de 10% das vendas da Albert Heijn. As lojas físicas permaneceram abertas e a agência de notícias holandesa ANP informou que os concorrentes registraram um aumento nos pedidos de entrega. Não ficou claro se havia alguma ligação entre o ataque ao supermercado francês e os problemas apontados pela Ahold Delhaize. A Ahold é a quarta maior varejista de supermercados dos EUA, e os sites de suas lojas Stop & Shop, Giant, Hannaford e Food Lion exibiam avisos informando que o site estava temporariamente fora do ar. Não ficou claro se outras operações foram afetadas. A fonte próxima a Lecornu afirmou que a ANSSI identificou uma vulnerabilidade em um software fornecido pela empresa dinamarquesa Danfoss. A Danfoss afirmou estar "ciente de incidentes na França que afetaram um número limitado de sistemas de gerenciamento de refrigeração". As unidades afetadas "estavam executando firmware desatualizado", disse a Danfoss, acrescentando que "há muito tempo aconselha os clientes a manterem os sistemas suportados atualizados com o firmware mais recente e a migrarem os sistemas legados para soluções de geração atual". Em 9 de agosto, a Team82, empresa de cibersegurança da Claroty, publicou uma análise detalhando vulnerabilidades no controlador Danfoss AK-SM 800A. A Team82 informou que a Danfoss atualizou seu software para corrigir as vulnerabilidades, que poderiam ter permitido burlar os procedimentos normais de login e executar códigos maliciosos em dispositivos comprometidos. Os ciberataques franceses apresentam semelhanças com as interrupções no fornecimento de refrigeração nos EUA no final de agosto, quando os refrigeradores dos refeitórios de cerca de uma dúzia de bases militares americanas foram afetados, resultando em perdas de alimentos.

item.title: Greenland lawmakers signal support for Trump security deal
item.description: A majority of Greenlandic lawmakers signalled support for the Arctic island's recent security agreement with US President Donald Trump in a debate on Monday, although some opposition party members questioned the deal's economic value.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A majority of Greenlandic lawmakers signalled support for the Arctic island's recent [USN:L6N45E07X TEXT:"security agreement"] with US President Donald Trump in a debate on Monday, although some opposition party members questioned the deal's economic value. The United States, Denmark and Greenland last month [USN:L6N45E0KZ TEXT:"signed the agreement"], aimed at ending tensions after Trump's repeated threats to take control of the strategically located and mineral-rich island. The agreement is subject to a second reading in parliament before being put to a vote, with lawmakers expected to pass the legislation. The deal [USN:L1N45D0X6 TEXT:"expands the US military's role"] in Greenland, paving the way for two new military bases and Trump's "Golden Dome" [USN:L1N41P17X TEXT:"missile defence system"], while reaffirming Danish sovereignty and Greenlanders' right to self-determination. The chair of opposition party Naleraq, Pele Broberg, said many details still remained unclear on how the agreement would work in practice. "The US is granted extensive rights in our country. The people of Greenland are not guaranteed any fixed payment for those rights," Broberg said in the parliamentary debate in Greenland's capital Nuuk. The government parties, which have a majority of seats, defended the deal. Former Foreign Minister Vivian Motzfeldt of the governing coalition's Demokraatit said Greenland had secured "massive" protection without having to pay for it, while winning recognition as an autonomous nation. Foreign Minister Mute Egede said the deal was "a huge step forward" that could not be measured in terms of money. Erik Jensen, chair of the Siumut party, said his party backed the deal. "For several years, Siumut has been campaigning to ensure that agreements concerning Greenland are no longer concluded without Greenlandic participation... That is why we are satisfied," Jensen said.

item.title: Qualifier Shi stuns Eala in Wuhan Open
item.description: Qualifier Shi Han stunned Alexandra Eala, ranked 198 places above her, in a 4-6 6-3 6-3 win at the Wuhan Open's first round on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Qualifier Shi Han stunned Alexandra Eala, ranked 198 places above her, in a 4-6 6-3 6-3 win at the Wuhan Open's first round on Monday. China's Shi, ranked 217th in the world, stuck to her strategy of targeting the edges of the court despite a first-set loss to the 13th seed, and pushed Eala back with powerful serves as she stormed to victory, cheered on by the home crowd. "I tried to push myself in the serve... tried my best to win," said the 21-year-old, who held her head in disbelief after her first win over a top-20 ranked opponent. The Philippines' Eala, who has risen to prominence with seven wins over top-10 ranked opponents this year, has struggled with her form over the last month, having also lost to 180th-ranked Tatiana Prozorova at the Singapore Open last month.

item.title: Rivalidade entre Europa e China ganha destaque no Salão do Automóvel de Paris
item.description: A indústria automobilística europeia reagiu à crescente concorrência chinesa no Salão do Automóvel de Paris, nesta segunda-feira, com uma onda de lançamentos de novos modelos e apoio renovado de Bruxelas, mesmo com as montadoras chinesas expandindo sua atuação na região.
item.dc:creator: Nick Carey, Giulio Piovaccari
item.content:encoded: A indústria automobilística europeia reagiu à crescente concorrência chinesa no Salão do Automóvel de Paris, nesta segunda-feira, com uma onda de lançamentos de novos modelos e apoio renovado de Bruxelas, mesmo com as montadoras chinesas expandindo sua atuação na região. O salão foi inaugurado dias depois de a União Europeia anunciar um acordo com a China para limitar as importações de veículos híbridos chineses para o bloco, com um limite de 350 mil unidades por ano, segundo um funcionário da Comissão Europeia. Embora os detalhes do acordo ainda não tenham sido finalizados, ele foi amplamente bem recebido pelos fabricantes europeus, embora alguns tenham afirmado que seria necessário mais apoio. O presidente da Stellantis (STLAM.MI) , Antonio Filosa, afirmou que o acordo foi um "bom marco", mas que a fabricante da Fiat também estava buscando ajuda do governo italiano para lidar com os altos custos de energia e queria que Bruxelas agisse mais rapidamente em relação às regras de emissões de carbono. A entrada maciça de veículos híbridos chineses na UE "não é sustentável", afirmou o presidente-executivo da Renault (RENA.PA) , François Provost, descrevendo o acordo como "melhor do que uma guerra comercial". Zhao Fei, presidente da montadora chinesa Changan (000625.SZ) , disse que "não estava muito preocupado" com o acordo, que considerava um precursor das regras de conteúdo local "Made in Europe", que poderiam ser resolvidas instalando a produção na região. Cerca de 20 marcas chinesas, incluindo BYD (002594.SZ) e Chery (9973.HK) , estão participando do evento, dobrando sua presença em relação a 2024 e buscando crescimento no exterior em meio à intensa concorrência e à demanda mais fraca no mercado interno. Nos últimos três anos, as marcas chinesas ganharam participação de mercado rapidamente na Europa, enquanto as exportações chinesas de veículos híbridos para os 27 estados-membros da UE triplicaram, atingindo US$7,5 bilhões no primeiro semestre deste ano, segundo dados da alfândega chinesa. O acordo UE-China pode afetar mais duramente a BYD, a Chery e a marca MG da estatal SAIC (600104.SS) , já que, juntas, representaram 90% das vendas de híbridos de marcas chinesas na UE nos primeiros oito meses de 2026, disseram analistas da Jefferies no domingo. A BYD afirmou que o acordo representou uma pressão de curto prazo, mas que continua comprometida com a Europa. Destacando os desafios enfrentados pelos fabricantes europeus, a Volkswagen informou na segunda-feira que suas entregas caíram 14,3% no terceiro trimestre, a maior queda trimestral em quatro anos, devido a um novo declínio na demanda em seu principal mercado, a China. As entregas também caíram na América do Norte e na Europa Ocidental. Como parte de seus esforços para recuperar participação no mercado europeu, a Stellantis está lançando seis novos modelos de suas marcas europeias no evento e apresentando nove carros-conceito. Na noite de domingo, o presidente-executivo Filosa saudou "a reinvenção de um ícone europeu" ao apresentar uma versão elétrica retrô acessível do Citroën 2CV. A empresa também está adotando ciclos de desenvolvimento mais rápidos, ao estilo chinês, afirmou o diretor de tecnologia, Ned Curic, ao detalhar os planos de construir pequenos veículos elétricos na Itália usando uma plataforma que está sendo desenvolvida em parceria com a chinesa Leapmotor. O chefe de crescimento da Renault, Fabrice Cambolive, afirmou na segunda-feira que a montadora poderá aumentar a produção de veículos elétricos na França em pelo menos 50% nos próximos 12 meses. 'SE ELES PARAREM DE EXPORTAR... ELES MORREM' Assim como outros salões do automóvel ocidentais, o de Paris estava em declínio até que as montadoras chinesas começaram a aparecer em peso há quatro anos. Além da BYD e da Chery, a edição deste ano do salão apresenta novas marcas chinesas, como a Aito, enquanto a estatal Changan lança suas marcas Nevo e Avatr na Europa. As montadoras chinesas também aproveitaram o evento para delinear planos de expansão na Europa. Zhao, da Changan, afirmou que a empresa está em negociações com fabricantes para a produção de veículos na Europa e espera produzir seu primeiro carro fabricado no continente no início de 2027. A BYD está estudando a possibilidade de construir uma fábrica na França, declarou a vice-presidente executiva Stella Li à emissora BFM TV. Em outubro de 2024, a UE impôs tarifas sobre veículos totalmente elétricos fabricados na China. Bruxelas também está trabalhando em regras "Made in Europe" que exigem níveis mínimos de conteúdo local para que os veículos elétricos tenham acesso a grande parte do mercado do bloco. O presidente francês, Emmanuel Macron, afirmou durante o evento que um acordo entre a França e a Alemanha sobre as disposições é "iminente". As montadoras chinesas têm buscado bases de produção na Europa antes da entrada em vigor das regras propostas, frequentemente em parceria com fabricantes já estabelecidos. Em julho, a Geely Auto <0175.HK>, da China, anunciou que produziria SUVs elétricos em uma fábrica da Ford Motor (F.N) na Espanha. Em comunicado separado, a Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles, da Índia, e a Stellantis anunciaram na segunda-feira que expandiram sua parceria para incluir tecnologia e desenvolvimento de produtos, com planos de fabricar veículos na Índia para mais de 50 mercados globais. As vendas de automóveis na China, o maior mercado automotivo do mundo, caíram 20% no primeiro semestre de 2026, aumentando a pressão sobre as montadoras para expandirem suas operações no exterior. Como o mercado norte-americano está praticamente fechado para a indústria automobilística chinesa, a Europa se tornou sua principal prioridade de exportação. "Se eles deixarem de exportar para a Europa, eles vão à falência porque não conseguem ganhar dinheiro em outros lugares", disse François Roudier, secretário-geral da Organização Internacional de Fabricantes de Veículos Automotores.

item.title: Microsoft planeja grande implantação de chips de IA próprios para reduzir custos
item.description: A Microsoft anunciou nesta segunda-feira a próxima geração de seu chip de inteligência artificial personalizado e disse que planeja implantar potencialmente mais de um milhão deles no próximo ano para dar suporte aos seus serviços internos de IA.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A Microsoft (MSFT.O) anunciou nesta segunda-feira a próxima geração de seu chip de inteligência artificial personalizado e disse que planeja implantar potencialmente mais de um milhão deles no próximo ano para dar suporte aos seus serviços internos de IA. O Maia 300, como o chip é chamado, é a terceira geração de chips personalizados da empresa, projetados para lidar com processamento de dados de IA, como codificação e execução de tarefas comerciais complexas em nome do usuário. Seu antecessor já executa modelos de IA internos da Microsoft, bem como modelos da OpenAI fornecidos no serviço de computação em nuvem Azure da Microsoft. A nova versão surge em meio a uma onda de chips personalizados de concorrentes de computação em nuvem e empresas de IA, como a OpenAI, com o objetivo de afrouxar o domínio da Nvidia (NVDA.O) no mercado de computação de IA. Para construir o chip, a Microsoft adotou uma abordagem técnica diferente da Nvidia, cujos aceleradores de IA utilizam um chip de computação massivo rodeado por chips de memória de alta largura de banda. O processador central do chip Maia 300 da Microsoft é composto por "chiplets" — geralmente chips especializados unidos — que utilizam tecnologia de 2 nanômetros da Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co (2330.TW) para funções computacionais essenciais. Outros chiplets incluídos no projeto utilizam tecnologia de 3 nanômetros, mais barata, para funções como a transferência de dados do processador para outras partes do sistema. Os processadores Maia 300 serão instalados em racks que contêm 96 chips e consomem cerca de 167 quilowatts de energia, em comparação com os 142 quilowatts consumidos pelos racks de servidores GB300 AI mais recentes da Nvidia, que possuem 72 unidades de processamento gráfico (GPUs). A Microsoft afirmou que os chips Maia 300 proporcionarão cerca de 40% mais computação útil por megawatt do que os "principais sistemas baseados em GPUs", embora não tenha especificado quais sistemas foram usados para a comparação. "Trata-se basicamente de fornecer mais inteligência para cada watt, cada dólar e cada byte de memória, otimizando todo o sistema", disse Rani Borkar, presidente de sistemas e infraestrutura de hardware do Azure na Microsoft, em entrevista à Reuters. A Microsoft afirmou que planeja implementar "implantações de múltiplos gigawatts" do chip Maia 300 a partir do próximo ano. A Microsoft também declarou que espera investir mais de US$ 175 bilhões em despesas de capital neste ano. (Por Stephen Nellis e Max Cherney)

item.title: Remessas globais de smartphones registram pior terceiro trimestre em 14 anos em meio à escassez de memória
item.description: As remessas globais de smartphones caíram 20% em relação ao ano anterior, atingindo o nível mais baixo para um terceiro trimestre desde 2012, devido ao aumento vertiginoso dos custos dos chips de memória e à escassez de suprimentos, que pressionaram os fabricantes e elevaram os preços, segundo estimativas preliminares da Counterpoint Research divulgadas nesta segunda-feira.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: As remessas globais de smartphones caíram 20% em relação ao ano anterior, atingindo o nível mais baixo para um terceiro trimestre desde 2012, devido ao aumento vertiginoso dos custos dos chips de memória e à escassez de suprimentos, que pressionaram os fabricantes e elevaram os preços, segundo estimativas preliminares da Counterpoint Research divulgadas nesta segunda-feira. O aumento dos preços dos componentes de memória, impulsionado pela crescente demanda em projetos de infraestrutura de IA, elevou os custos de produção e levou os fabricantes a aumentarem os preços de varejo, reduzirem os embarques e priorizarem a lucratividade em detrimento do volume. "Os consumidores estão mantendo seus dispositivos por mais tempo do que o estimado, considerando cada vez mais aparelhos recondicionados e priorizando dispositivos de maior valor", disse Shilpi Jain, analista sênior da Counterpoint. A Samsung (005930.KS) manteve a liderança com 23% de participação de mercado, impulsionada pela demanda da linha Galaxy Z Fold8 e pelo fornecimento estável de componentes para seus dispositivos de gama média. As remessas caíram 3% em relação ao ano anterior durante o trimestre. A participação de mercado da Apple (AAPL.O) atingiu 22%, ultrapassando os 20% pela primeira vez no terceiro trimestre, apesar da queda anual nas remessas. A ausência de um modelo básico do iPhone 18 resultou em uma menor disponibilidade nos canais de distribuição no mês de lançamento em comparação com toda a linha do iPhone 17 um ano antes, afirmou a Counterpoint. A OPPO e a vivo registraram quedas de mais de 20% nas remessas. A Xiaomi (1810.HK) registrou uma queda de mais de 30%, reduzindo sua participação de mercado para 10%, à medida que diminuiu sua exposição a dispositivos de menor preço e a alguns mercados estrangeiros para proteger suas margens de lucro. (Por Harshita Mary Varghese)

item.title: Italian clubs condemn fans' violence as rivalry returns
item.description: Milano Hockey Club and HC Bolzano Foxes have condemned a clash between their supporters after the sides met at the newly-opened Fiera Ice Arena in Milan.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Milano Hockey Club and HC Bolzano Foxes have condemned a clash between their supporters after the sides met at the newly-opened Fiera Ice Arena in Milan. The hockey rivalry between Milan and Bolzano, one of the biggest clubs in Italy, was renewed after a 14-year gap when [USN:L8N45Q06J TEXT:"Milano HC was formed"] following the success of the ice hockey tournaments at this year's Winter Olympics in the city. The new arena hosted the Milan club's first home game on Friday against HC Innsbruck, and a sell-out crowd attended Sunday's match between the two Italian sides. Police intervened after an incident between supporters following the game. A police spokesperson told Reuters that a small group of Milano HC supporters kicked out at a bus containing Bolzano fans as it departed. Two individuals were identified by police and will receive bans from attending the arena. A 42-year-old man was reported for possession of an object which could be used as a weapon. "Behaviour of this kind is unacceptable and does not represent the values of the sport, nor the passion and respect that distinguish the vast majority of supporters of both teams," the clubs said in a joint statement on Monday. Milano HC took the lead three times in the game but lost 4-3 in overtime.

item.title: Musk has spent $366 million to help Republicans retain control of Congress
item.description: Elon Musk has spent roughly $366 million on the 2026 midterm elections so far, $276 million just since July, trying to help Republicans retain control of Congress, even as Democrats' chances of retaking the US House and Senate have improved.
item.dc:creator: Dawn Kopecki
item.content:encoded:
Elon Musk has spent roughly $366 million on the 2026 midterm elections so far, $276 million just since July, trying to help Republicans retain control of Congress, even as Democrats' chances of retaking the US House and Senate have improved. Musk's largess, which was reported earlier by the New York Times, makes the world's richest person likely the single-biggest political donor in this year's races, according to campaign finance records. There is a lot at stake for Musk with House Democrats calling for investigations into his [USN:L1N3OW1IO TEXT:"government contracts"] as CEO of aerospace company SpaceX (SPCX.O) as well as his work running the Department of Government Efficiency under President Donald Trump . Here's a breakdown of his political spending, which was confirmed by a spokesman for his super PAC America PAC. Musk has spent $366 million so far this election cycle, which began January 1, 2025. Of that, Musk has donated at least $276 million to Republican groups and his own super PAC since July. Of the $276 million in third-quarter donations: $158 million went to the Senate Leadership Fund, the super PAC set up to help elect Republicans to the Senate that is aligned with Senate Majority Leader John Thune, a Republican from South Dakota. $20 million went to the Congressional Leadership Fund, the super PAC set up for House Republicans that is aligned with House Speaker Mike Johnson, a Louisiana Republican. $76 million went to Musk's America PAC. $10 million went to the Lone Star Liberty PAC, which is supporting Republican state Attorney General Ken Paxton's run for the US Senate in Texas, where recent polls have him in a dead heat against Democrat James Talarico. $10 million went to the Republican Governors Association. $2 million went to the Republican Attorneys General Association.

America PAC is helping Republican candidates in seven battleground states and nearly three dozen House races. The new giving will be publicly disclosed when many super PACs are required to disclose their third-quarter spending on Thursday. Musk has also donated more money through groups that don't disclose their donors, according to the New York Times report and confirmed by an America PAC spokesman. Musk spent roughly $290 million during the last election cycle.

PARIS, Oct 12 : France's LVMH on Monday reported worse-than-expected third-quarter organic sales growth as weak demand for its fashion and leather goods weighed.  Organic sales, which strip out currency swings, rose 1 per cent year-on-year to €18.28 billion ($20.40 billion), compared with the 1.3 per cent increase expected by analysts in Visible Alpha consensus. The fashion and leather goods division, which includes flagship brands Louis Vuitton and Dior and generates nearly half of group revenue, posted a 5 per cent fall in organic sales, against an expected 1.8 per cent decline.  The trading update from LVMH - the world's largest luxury group and the first major firm to report third-quarter results - looked likely to further unsettle investors amid fears that the $350 billion luxury sector, mired in a three-year slowdown, will struggle to regain its former momentum. ($1 = 0.8960 euros)

(reporting by Tassilo Hummel, editing by Dominique Patton )

item.title: 欧州外為市場＝ドル1年半ぶり高値圏、中東情勢と米物価指標に警戒
item.description: ［ニューヨーク／ロンドン １２日 ロイター］ - １２日の欧州外為市場では、ドルは１年半ぶりの高値近辺で推移した。中...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
欧州外為市場＝ドル1年半ぶり高値圏、中東情勢と米物価指標に警戒 0:51 配信

2023年3月10日に撮影. REUTERS/Dado Ruvic/Illustration/File Photo

［ニューヨーク／ロンドン　１２日　ロイター］　 - １２日の欧州外為市場では、ドルは１年半ぶりの高値近辺で推移した。中東紛争の激化と週内に発表される重要な米物価指標を前に、投資家が慎重姿勢を維持する中、安全資産としての需要がドルを支えた。

主要６通貨に対するドルの値動きを示すドル指数は０．１６％高の１０２．３９。先週付けた１年半ぶりの高値をわずかに下回る水準にある。

米市場規制当局の週間データによると、投資家はドルの買い持ちを積み増しており、１０月７日までの１週間では約３６０億ドルと、３週間前の８４億ドルから増加した。主にユーロが売られた。

ロンドンのＬＭＡＸグループの市場ストラテジスト、ジョエル・クルーガー氏は「市場は比較的明るいムードで週を迎えたが、その後は地政学的な不透明感の再燃と原油高がリスク選好を圧迫し、地合いが悪化した。これが新たな米ドル需要を促している」と述べた。

１４日に発表される米消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）は、今月の米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）の金融政策会合を前にした最後の主要経済指標の一つで、ドルの短期的な方向を左右する重要な材料となりそうだ。

市場は追加利上げの可能性を見極めようと経済指標を注視している。ＣＭＥのフェドウオッチによると、市場が織り込む今月の金利据え置き確率は８１％と、１カ月前の５１％から上昇した。

ユーロは０．１９％安の１．１１８０ドル。２０２７年の大統領選を前にフランスの財政健全性に対する投資家の懸念が重しとなり、先週まで５週連続で下落した。

ドル／円は１５８．５７円と小幅高。日本が祝日のため商いは薄かった。英ポンドは１．３２３ドルでほぼ横ばいだった。

item.title: USA Perquisition au domicile de l'élue démocrate Ilhan Omar, cible de Donald Trump
item.description: Des agents du département de la Sécurité intérieure ont mené lundi avant l'aube une perquisition au domicile de la représentante démocrate du Minnesota Ilhan Omar, dans la région de Washington, dans le cadre d'une enquête fédérale visant l'élue d'origine somalienne, a annoncé le département de la Justice.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Des agents du département de la Sécurité intérieure ont mené lundi avant l'aube une perquisition au domicile de la représentante démocrate du Minnesota Ilhan Omar, dans la région de Washington, dans le cadre d'une enquête fédérale visant l'élue d'origine somalienne, a annoncé le département de la Justice. Selon une source proche du dossier, cette opération s'inscrit dans le cadre d'une enquête pénale pour fraude relative aux documents d'immigration d'Ilhan Omar, 44 ans, remplis par son défunt père alors qu'elle était enfant. Ilhan Omar est née à Mogadiscio en 1982 et avait trouvé refuge avec sa famille au Kenya durant la guerre civile somalienne avant d'émigrer aux Etats-Unis avec les siens, dans l'Etat du Minnesota. "Aujourd’hui, dans la région de Washington, D.C., le service des enquêtes de la Sécurité intérieure (Homeland Security Investigations) a exécuté un mandat de perquisition autorisé par la justice et délivré par le ministère de la Justice. Cette mesure coercitive s’inscrit dans le cadre d’une enquête fédérale en cours", a déclaré un porte-parole du ministère de la Justice dans un e-mail. Le département de Sécurité intérieure fait partie de l'ICE, le service de l'immigration et des douanes des Etats-Unis, à la réputation entachée par plusieurs incidents graves depuis le début du mandat de Donald Trump. Le porte-parole d'Ilhan Omar n’a pas répondu dans l'immédiat à une demande de commentaire. Cette perquisition intervient un peu plus de trois semaines avant les élections de mi-mandat du 3 novembre, lors desquelles les républicains tenteront de conserver leur courte majorité au Congrès américain. Ilhan Omar, figure de l'aile progressiste du Parti démocrate qui brigue un nouveau mandat à la Chambre des représentants, est régulièrement la cible d'insultes de la part de Donald Trump, qui présente la communauté somalienne aux Etats-Unis comme une menace pour le Minnesota. "UNE OBSESSION INQUIÉTANTE" Ilhan Omar, qui critique ouvertement le président américain, a qualifié l’attention qu’il lui porte "d’obsession malsaine et effrayante". La semaine dernière, Donald Trump a qualifié Abdul El-Sayed, candidat démocrate au Sénat américain pour le Michigan de confession musulmane, "d’extrémiste RADICAL" et de "sympathisant des terroristes", tout en apportant son soutien au candidat républicain, Mike Rogers. Les défenseurs des droits civiques dénoncent la rhétorique agressive et injurieuse du président républicain à l’égard des minorités et des immigrés. Il avait notamment qualifié les Somaliens de "déchets". En février, Donald Trump a déclaré qu’Ilhan Omar et la représentante démocrate du Michigan Rashida Tlaib, elle aussi musulmane, devraient être "internées" et renvoyées "d’où elles viennent". Les deux élues avaient critiqué le président lors de son discours sur l’état de l’Union, alors qu’il vantait la politique d’immigration intransigeante de son administration et ses mesures de répression en matière d’immigration. Ilhan Omar a déclaré à plusieurs reprises qu’elle et sa famille avaient reçu des menaces de mort, qu’elle attribue à une "rhétorique politique haineuse". Le mois dernier, un citoyen du Minnesota qui avait aspergé l'élue de vinaigre a été condamné à un an et deux mois de prison après avoir plaidé coupable d’agression sur un fonctionnaire. Anthony James Kazmierczak a admis avoir attaqué Ilhan Omar parce qu’il était en désaccord avec ses opinions politiques.

item.title: ＮＡＴＯ軍司令官、ロシアの攻撃に強硬対応を警告「愚かな行為」
item.description:
Andrew Gray Justyna Pawlak
[ブリュッセル／ワルシャワ １２日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Andrew Gray　Justyna Pawlak

[ブリュッセル／ワルシャワ １２日 ロイター] - 北大西洋条約機構（ＮＡＴＯ）の欧州連合軍最高司令官、アレクサス・グリンケウィッチ米空軍大将は１２日、ロシアが「愚かにも」加盟国の領域を攻撃すれば、攻撃に関わる「あらゆるもの」を破壊すると警告した。

ワルシャワ安全保障フォーラムで演説したグリンケウィッチ氏は、敵部隊を阻止し、攻撃力をそぎ、打ち破るという３段階の対応により、いかなる攻撃も「完全に無駄に終わらせる」と言明した。

グリンケウィッチ氏はロシアを名指ししなかったが、発言の多くは明らかにロシアに向けられていた。ＮＡＴＯの２０２２年の「戦略概念」は、ロシアを同盟にとって最も重大な安全保障上の脅威と位置付けている。

同氏は「誰かが愚かにもわれわれを攻撃すれば、われわれは戦う」と述べた。「要するに、どの同盟国へのいかなる攻撃も、完全に無駄に終わるようにする」

欧州とロシアの緊張が高まる中での発言だが、欧州の同盟国の間では、トランプ米大統領がＮＡＴＯの相互防衛の約束を守るかどうかへの懸念も根強い。

トランプ氏はここ数日、ロシアによる世界市場への軽油供給を認めることで同国のプーチン大統領と合意したと発表したほか、ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領への批判を再開した。

item.title: China gloom hits LVMH, dims hopes of luxury revival
item.description: Luxury bellwether LVMH on Monday reported weaker-than-expected third-quarter sales as a sharp deterioration in Chinese consumer mood hit demand for its flagship brands Louis Vuitton and Dior.
item.dc:creator: Tassilo Hummel, Alessandro Parodi
item.content:encoded: Luxury bellwether LVMH (LVMH.PA) on Monday reported weaker-than-expected third-quarter sales as a sharp deterioration in Chinese consumer mood hit demand for its flagship brands Louis Vuitton and Dior. The trading update from the world's largest luxury group, and the first major sector player to report third-quarter results, is likely to heighten concerns that the $350 billion luxury industry, mired in a three-year slowdown, will struggle to regain momentum. Europe's leading luxury groups have lost around €330 billion in market value since the start of the year, with LVMH alone shedding roughly 40%. LVMH's US-listed shares fell more than 3% after the trading update was published. Organic sales, which strip out currency swings, rose 1% from a year earlier to €18.5 billion ($20.7 billion), missing analysts' expectations for growth of 1.3%, according to a Visible Alpha consensus. The fashion and leather goods division, which generates nearly half of group revenue, posted a 5% fall in organic sales, against an expected 1.8% decline. "We think results will likely still be a negative catalyst for the sector overall," Bank of America analysts said in a note. RBC analyst Piral Dadhania said he expected "modest pressure" on the stocks of LVMH and its peers following the results. Adding to investor concerns, growth in LVMH's watches and jewellery division, home to brands including Bulgari and Tiffany, slowed to 6% from 9% in the first half of the year. The so-called "hard luxury" category, which many consumers see as offering more value than handbags and fashion, has largely withstood the broader downturn. Some analysts, however, have recently warned that resilience may be fading. Sales in Asia, dominated by China, fell 5% from a year earlier, while sales in the US rose 5%. "In the third quarter specifically, Asia was penalised by a sharp macro-led deterioration in Chinese consumer sentiment, with a tangible impact on discretionary expenses," Chief Financial Officer Cecile Cabanis told analysts. China's [USN:L6N45H0G7 TEXT:"tax crackdown"] on wealthy individuals has become the latest headache for luxury brands, which are already grappling with the fallout from the Iran war and signs of slowing consumer spending in the US. Asked about the tax crackdown on a call with analysts, Cabanis said Chinese consumers' "feel good" factor had taken a hit. Chinese consumers account for roughly a fifth of global luxury purchases and were long the driving force behind the sector's growth. Demand has weakened sharply since the pandemic. LVMH's fashion and leather goods division is dominated by Louis Vuitton, by far the group's largest brand. After proving more resilient than many rivals during the luxury downturn, its momentum has recently stalled. The label has also faced a consumer backlash in China over a copyright dispute with tea chain Molly Tea, which used a logo resembling the floral motif featured on Louis Vuitton's signature monogram handbags. Asked whether Vuitton could follow sister brand Dior in replacing its creative directors, Cabanis declined to comment but said the brand needed to step up its efforts and strike the right balance between innovation and heritage. Cabanis said she did not believe in "drastic measures" such as price cuts to revive the brand. Birkin bag maker Hermes and Gucci-owner Kering are due to publish third-quarter sales next week. ($1 = 0.8960 euros)

item.title: Getty Images plans bankruptcy filing, to go private
item.description: Getty Images said on Monday it would file for bankruptcy and go private after a restructuring agreement that the visual-content provider expects to close by the end of the year.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Getty Images (GETY.PK) said on Monday it would file for bankruptcy and go private after a restructuring agreement that the visual-content provider expects to close by the end of the year. The company plans to begin an expedited prepackaged Chapter 11 process in the coming weeks, a major reset after the [USN:L4N4321Q8 TEXT:"collapse of its planned merger"] with rival Shutterstock (SSTK.N) amid heavy debt and growing competition from AI-generated imagery. Once the restructuring is complete, affiliates of the Getty family and Koch Equity Development will own 100% of the company. The investors have also committed to provide up to $533 million of new equity, Getty said. Holders of Getty's unsecured bonds agreed to retire $270 million of notes, while secured lenders agreed to reduce interest costs and extend debt maturities under the restructuring plan. The company added that operations would continue normally and vendors would be paid in full in the ordinary course. Getty, which competes with Reuters and the Associated Press in providing photos and videos for editorial use, said financing from Koch Equity Development of up to $143 million would support the restructuring process. In August, Getty withdrew its financial guidance, citing an ongoing review of strategic financing alternatives and balance-sheet management initiatives, and said it had engaged Guggenheim Securities to advise on those efforts. The visual-content provider reported total debt of about $2.1 billion as of June 30, compared with a market valuation of $20.74 million as of Friday's close. Getty shares have lost about 99% of their value since returning to public markets in 2022 through a [USN:L4N2SV2B3 TEXT:"special purpose acquisition company"] that valued the company at about $4.8 billion, after 14 years as a private firm. The New York Stock Exchange commenced delisting proceedings against the company at the end of September.

item.title: US DEA proposes strictest drug controls on kratom-linked products exceeding certain thresholds
item.description: The US Drug Enforcement Administration has proposed emergency restrictions placing some products with synthetic opioid-like compounds derived from kratom under the strictest category of federal drug control, if they exceed certain concentrations.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The US Drug Enforcement Administration has proposed emergency restrictions placing some products with synthetic opioid-like compounds derived from kratom under the strictest category of federal drug control, if they exceed certain concentrations. The DEA issued two notices of intent on Friday, based on recommendations from the US Department of Health and Human Services, to distinguish products containing trace amounts of the substances from intentionally enhanced or concentrated formulations. The action targets four substances linked to kratom, a plant from Southeast Asia known to produce opioid-like effects The DEA is targeting 7-hydroxymitragynine (7-OH), found in trace amounts in kratom, and three related opioid substances derived or chemically modified from the plant: mitragynine pseudoindoxyl (MGPI), MGM-15, and MGM-16 The DEA proposed that products in which 7-OH and MGPI exceed certain concentrations, or fall below a specified mitragynine-to-7-OH/MGPI ratio, be temporarily placed in Schedule I Schedule I of the Controlled Substances Act is reserved for drugs with a high potential for abuse and no currently accepted medical use in the United States The DEA in August cited an immediate threat to public safety to temporarily [USN:L4N44M11L TEXT:"place"] MGPI, MGM-15 and MGM-16 under the strictest category of federal drug control For 7-OH, the DEA said it had not yet issued a temporary scheduling order and would release a revised notice reflecting HHS's updated recommendation

item.title: England increase central contracts to record 39
item.description: England have expanded their number of centrally contracted players to a record 39, including 30 full contracts, the ECB said on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: England have expanded their number of centrally contracted players to a record 39, including 30 full contracts, the ECB said on Monday. Former captain Ben Stokes and fast bowler Mark Wood retired from internationals this year, and opener Zak Crawley and left-arm seamer Luke Wood did not get renewed contracts. Uncapped seamer Henry Crocombe was awarded a two-year deal as one of seven players added to England's full-contract list for the first time. Jordan Cox also received a two-year deal, and Tom Banton, Sam Cook, Emilio Gay, Matthew Fisher and Dan Lawrence earned one-year contracts. Seam bowler Ollie Robinson returned to the list after holding central contracts in 2022 and 2023. England now have 11 players on two-year contracts, with test captain Joe Root, one-day skipper Harry Brook, Jofra Archer and Jacob Bethell among nine whose deals have been extended until September 2028. (This story has been corrected to clarify that Ben Stokes and Mark Wood retired from internationals this year, not last year, in paragraph 2.)

RIYADH: Saudi Arabia said it was facing a new barrage of incoming fire on Monday (Oct 12) and that Riyadh airport would remain shut for now, days after Saturday's deadly missile strike on a departure terminal that was claimed by Yemen's Iran-allied Houthis.  Incoming drones and missiles were reported by the Saudi-led coalition backing government forces in Yemen, though there was no immediate news of whether they were intercepted.  The Houthis have been attacking Saudi airports and oil facilities since last week as part of a rapidly escalating conflict that has spilt over from the wider regional conflagration between the United States and Iran. Those attacks have shut down parts of Saudi airspace, suspending operations at Riyadh airport, and largely emptying the skies over the capital even as the city hosts a major energy conference.

Saudi Arabia now faces a nightmare predicament, having re-entered Yemen's civil war to push the Houthis from the vital Bab el-Mandeb Strait oil route and stop the group making further gains after its sudden advances in September.  With the Yemeni forces Riyadh supports having made some gains against the Houthis around Bab el-Mandeb but still on the back foot on other fronts, Yemeni military sources said any pressure on the Houthis could take time to pay off.  Saudi Arabia's long-time regional rival Iran offered to mediate between its Houthi allies and the kingdom.  "We have repeatedly expressed our readiness to help facilitate dialogue between the parties," foreign ministry spokesperson Esmaeil Baqaei said on Monday.  Meanwhile, despite intensified Saudi airstrikes against the group, including what Yemeni television said were hits on al-Jawf province on Monday, the Houthis show no sign of letting up their own barrage of attacks on Saudi infrastructure.  The group has repeatedly threatened to target airports and airspace, as well as Saudi oil installations that provide the engine for the kingdom's economy and its ambitious development plans.

UAE CALLS FOR JOINT GULF ACTION Saudi Energy Minister Prince Abdulaziz Salman said at Monday's conference that the kingdom would stay focused on bringing in investment as part of its wider economic development goals.  "The development of our energy system and industrial capability continues," he said.  Saudi Arabia's neighbour, the United Arab Emirates, on Monday called for a revival of joint Gulf action on security and defence in response to the attacks.  UAE presidential adviser Anwar Gargash said the targeting of Saudi Arabia undermined the security of all Gulf states and added that the neglect of collective Gulf security had "emboldened others" to overreach against regional states.  Saudi Arabia and the UAE had been partners in the Yemen conflict for years, but they backed different forces within the Yemeni military coalition supporting the government and fell out last winter.  US President Donald Trump said on Saturday that Washington was considering joining Saudi Arabia in strikes on the Houthis, but there has been no sign yet of any US action.

item.title: UK PM Burnham says Iran's IRGC likely behind RAF Fairford incident
item.description: British Prime Minister Andy Burnham said on Monday that a suspected plot targeting the RAF Fairford air base in Britain was "highly likely" to have been coordinated in Iran, and almost certainly directed by the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps.
item.dc:creator: Michael Holden
item.content:encoded: British Prime Minister Andy Burnham said on Monday that a suspected plot targeting the RAF Fairford air base in Britain was "highly likely" to have been coordinated in Iran, and almost certainly directed by the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps. The [USN:L1N45R08W TEXT:"RAF Fairford"] base in southwest England, which had been used by US bombers to carry out strikes on Iran, became the focal point for a major security response after five British men were arrested nearby in the early hours of September 27 on suspected terrorism and explosive offences. US officials have told Reuters that there had been a suspected plot involving Iran to [USN:L1N45S0OK TEXT:"launch a drone attack"], and last week US President Donald Trump said a threat linked to Iran [USN:L1N45R04X TEXT:"had prompted a decision"] to withdraw the bombers from the base. "I can confirm our assessment that it is highly likely to have been coordinated in Iran, almost certainly directed by Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard," Burnham told parliament. Iran has rejected any connection with the Fairford incident. "Tehran has had no involvement in this matter, and if the British government possesses any documents or evidence to support its claims, it should present them," [USN:S8N44X01J TEXT:"said Iran's Ambassador to Britain"], Seyed Ali Mousavi, according to Iran's state news agency IRNA. FAIRFORD PLOT DETAILS SKETCHY Details around the suspected plot remain thin. The five detained men were later released without charge on police bail "under stringent conditions", and two other arrested men, including a British-Iranian national, [USN:L8N45U0PF TEXT:"have also been released"]. Detectives have said petrol but no viable explosive had been found in vans seized along with the five men. However, both police and Burnham have pointed towards the involvement of a foreign state. British interior minister Shabana Mahmood told parliament a known individual, whom she did not name, who was based in Iran was believed to be behind what had happened. "We will not tolerate these threats on our soil," Burnham said. "We will crack down on Iran's use of criminal networks, using our full range of powers to target them and their funding streams, and we will bring further sanctions to restrict the capacity of Iran and the IRGC to do us harm." Foreign ministries from almost 30 countries including the US, Canada, France and Germany issued a statement condemning "Iran’s use of violent attacks, including the acts of lethal plotting, arson, sabotage, cyber-attacks, and other hybrid activities against us and our partners". "The UK has also concluded this event demonstrates the IRGC’s continued willingness to project hostile activity beyond its borders through covert networks and proxy actors," the statement said. The British authorities have for a number of years accused Iran of being involved in numerous plots and attempted assassinations in Britain using criminal networks and proxies, accusations Tehran has repeatedly denied. Last year Britain said there had been 20 credible Iranian-backed threats to kill or kidnap individuals based in the UK. In July, Britain used new powers to ban support for the IRGC and a linked group, Harakat Ashab al-Yamin al-Islamiya (HAYI), which had claimed responsibility for seven attacks earlier this year at locations linked to Jewish and Israeli communities, and Persian-language media. British foreign minister Ed Miliband said he had summoned the Iranian ambassador while the ministry announced two Iranian nationals [USN:S8N44301J TEXT:"had been sanctioned"]. The two men were Ruhollah Bazghandi, who Britain said was the IRGC's head of counterespionage operations, and Shahram Ali Reza Tamarzadeh Jakki, a facilitator for the already sanctioned Zindashti criminal network which is accused of involvement in several plots against Iranian dissidents.

LONDON, Oct 12 : Players who sign up for LIV Golf next season will not be allowed to become members of the European Tour, DP World Tour Chief Executive Officer Guy Kinnings told the BBC on Monday. Kinnings said that players must now make a choice. "We have rules and regulations which are there to protect our tour and which our members must all abide by. Players who are not willing to comply with our rules and regulations should not be seeking to join our tour," he added. LIV Golf was not immediately available for comment.

item.title: Nigeria's Dangote refinery extends $1.6 billion IPO to broaden African investor access
item.description: Nigeria's Dangote Petroleum Refinery and Petrochemicals has extended the application period for its initial public offering by two weeks to October 27, citing strong investor interest across Africa and efforts to broaden access to the share sale.
item.dc:creator: Chijioke Ohuocha, Macdonald Dzirutwe
item.content:encoded: Nigeria's Dangote Petroleum Refinery and Petrochemicals has extended the application period for its [USN:L1N456052 TEXT:"initial public offering"] by two weeks to October 27, citing strong investor interest across Africa and efforts to broaden access to the share sale. The company said on Monday that Nigeria's Securities and Exchange Commission had approved the extension of the offer, which opened on September 14 and had been due to close on October 13. Reuters earlier reported the extension of what is set to be Africa's largest share sale. The refinery, owned by Africa's richest person, Aliko Dangote, is seeking to broaden ownership of its 700,000-barrel-per-day complex through an offer aimed at up to 10 million retail investors in Nigeria and elsewhere across the continent. The company said the extension would support market-access initiatives in other African countries, including expanding distribution channels and facilitating cross-border investment. It said the additional time would also allow prospective investors to complete account-opening procedures, identity verification checks and other regulatory requirements needed to participate in the offer. The prospectus showed the share sale was not registered as a public offering outside Nigeria, forcing investors to rely on local regulations or gain access through a limited number of eligible online investment platforms. The mismatch between Dangote's pan-African ambitions and the uneven take-up beyond Nigeria highlights how fragmented capital markets continue to hinder [USN:L8N45D1AE TEXT:"cross-border investment"] across the continent. The IPO aims to raise around $1.6 billion — or up to $2.1 billion if an over-allotment option is exercised — from retail investors to help fund the expansion of the Lagos refinery. The refinery, which began processing crude in early 2024, is central to Nigeria's efforts to reduce fuel imports and become a net exporter of refined petroleum products. The offering is viewed as a major test of pan-African retail investor appetite for ownership in a large industrial asset.

PARIS, Oct 12 : Hackers forced the temperature of many French supermarket fridges up to 50 degrees Celsius (122°F) overnight, causing fires and food losses at several hundred stores across the country in a major cyberattack. The Paris prosecutor's office said a "large-scale" attack was "affecting connected refrigerators in several major food retailers across France" and reported damage included "food losses and fires". Meanwhile, Prime Minister Sebastien Lecornu instructed France's National Cybersecurity Agency ANSSI to investigate, a person in his office said. They said France "was coordinating with its European counterparts, as other countries may also be affected," while also investigating whether any other French firms were at risk.

Les Mousquetaires, which owns retailer Intermarche, said around 150 of its stores had been hit, with fridges heated up to 50 degrees Celsius for six hours. It had thrown all the food away to avoid any sanitary risks, a spokesperson said. And Cooperative U CEO Dominique Schelcher said his supermarket had also been hit by the attack. "Targeting equipment essential to the preservation of fresh products and to the food supply of the French people is of extreme gravity and is unprecedented," he wrote on X. Carrefour said 80 of its supermarkets had been hit but that the vast majority of its 6,000 stores had not been affected.  Several other supermarket chains, including Monoprix, E.Leclerc and Auchan, did not respond to requests for comment. DUTCH SECURITY ISSUE Dutch supermarket operator Ahold Delhaize, which operates the Netherlands' largest supermarket chain Albert Heijn and has substantial operations in the United States, said it was also dealing with a "security issue" in its network, and had taken several systems offline to protect them. A smartphone app for the retailer told clients that due to a "cybersecurity incident" it was unable to deliver groceries. Online orders represent around 10 per cent of sales for Albert Heijn. Physical stores remained open and Dutch news agency ANP reported that rivals had seen an influx of delivery orders. It was not clear if there was any link between the French supermarket attack and the problems flagged by Ahold Delhaize.  Ahold is the fourth-largest grocery retailer in the US, where websites for its Stop & Shop, Giant, Hannaford and Food Lion stores all had notices saying "site temporarily down". It was unclear if other operations were affected. The source close to Lecornu said ANSSI had identified a vulnerability in software supplied by Danish company Danfoss. Danfoss said it was "aware of incidents in France affecting a limited number of refrigeration management systems". The affected units "were running outdated firmware", Danfoss said, adding that it had "long advised customers to keep supported systems updated with the latest firmware and to migrate legacy systems to current-generation solutions".

Source: Reuters

item.title: Hackers heat French supermarket fridges, sparking fires and spoiling food
item.description: Hackers raised the temperature of refrigerators and freezers at hundreds of French supermarkets to as high as 50 degrees Celsius (122 degrees Fahrenheit) overnight, causing fires and spoiling food.
item.dc:creator: Leo Marchandon, Gabriel Stargardter
item.content:encoded: Hackers raised the temperature of refrigerators and freezers at hundreds of French supermarkets to as high as 50 degrees Celsius (122 degrees Fahrenheit) overnight, causing fires and spoiling food. The Paris prosecutor's office said on Monday that a "large-scale" attack was "affecting connected refrigerators in several major food retailers across France", leading to food losses and fires. Prime Minister Sebastien Lecornu has instructed France's National Cybersecurity Agency (ANSSI) to investigate, a person in his office said. France was coordinating with European counterparts because other countries could also be affected, the person said, adding that authorities were assessing whether other French companies were at risk. Felix Aime, a senior cyber threat intelligence analyst at Sekoia Threat Detection and Research, said Spain, Portugal, Poland, Germany and Belgium had also been affected. Carrefour (CARR.PA) said 80 of its supermarkets were hit, while Monoprix, which operates about 490 stores in France, said 5% of its stores were affected. Les Mousquetaires, owner of retailer Intermarche, said fridges at around 150 of its stores were heated up to 50 C for six hours overnight. A spokesperson said all affected food had been discarded to eliminate health risks. Paris resident Geert de Clercq witnessed staff at an Intermarche in central Paris throwing cartfuls of defrosted frozen foods into a giant trash container, with molten ice cream sloshing out of broken tubs on the street. Cooperative U CEO Dominique Schelcher said his supermarket group had also been targeted. "Targeting equipment essential to the preservation of fresh products and to the food supply of the French people is of extreme gravity and is unprecedented," he wrote on X. Food retailers E.Leclerc and Auchan did not respond to requests for comment. There was no immediate estimate of industry-wide losses, but Intermarche CEO Thierry Cotillard told BFM TV the "unprecedented" attack would represent losses amounting to "tens of millions of euros nationwide in a single day." Christel Delberghe, director general at European retail association Eurocommerce, said, "This incident underlines the importance of resilience across the entire supply chain." COLD AISLES CONTROLLED OVER INTERNET Supermarket cold aisles are typically run by control panels that manage an entire store's fridges and freezers and can be accessed over the internet, which lets maintenance companies adjust them from anywhere. The source close to Lecornu said ANSSI had identified a vulnerability in software supplied by Danish company Danfoss. Danfoss said it was "aware of incidents in France affecting a limited number of refrigeration management systems". The affected units "were running outdated firmware", Danfoss said, adding that it had "long advised customers to keep supported systems updated with the latest firmware and to migrate legacy systems to current-generation solutions". On August 9, cybersecurity firm Claroty's Team82 published research detailing vulnerabilities in the Danfoss AK-SM 800A controller. According to the report, software updates issued by Danfoss addressed issues that could have allowed attackers to bypass authentication controls and execute code on compromised devices. The attacks resemble disruptions reported at about a dozen US military commissaries in late August that led to food losses after fridges were affected. In a statement, French retail association Fédération du Commerce et de la Distribution called for "full transparency" from Danfoss about the incident. It said supermarkets aimed to protect consumers and return to normal operations as soon as possible. The FCD said some impacted stores were already back up and running. DUTCH SECURITY ISSUE Dutch retailer Ahold Delhaize (AD.AS) , which operates the Netherlands' largest supermarket chain Albert Heijn and has major operations in the US, said it was dealing with a "security issue" on its network and had taken several systems offline as a precaution. A message on the retailer's smartphone app said it was unable to deliver groceries because of a "cybersecurity incident". Online orders account for about 10% of Albert Heijn sales. Physical stores remained open, while Dutch news agency ANP reported that rival retailers had seen a surge in delivery orders. Ahold Delhaize said there was no reason to see a link between the incidents in France and its supermarkets. Ahold is the fourth-largest grocery retailer in the US. Websites for its Stop & Shop, Giant, Hannaford and Food Lion chains displayed notices saying "site temporarily down". It was unclear whether other operations had been affected.

item.title: Hurricane Simon crawls along Mexico's Pacific coast, bringing floods and evacuations
item.description: Hurricane Simon crept northwest just off Mexico's Pacific coast on Monday, lashing western states with dangerous winds, heavy rain and flooding that put riverside communities on alert for possible evacuations.
item.dc:creator: Alberto Fajardo, Daniel Becerril
item.content:encoded: Hurricane Simon crept northwest just off Mexico's Pacific coast on Monday, lashing western states with dangerous winds, heavy rain and flooding that put riverside communities on alert for possible evacuations. The US National Hurricane Center said Simon was about 55 miles (90 km) west-southwest of Cabo Corrientes in Jalisco state at 8 a.m. (1400 GMT), packing maximum sustained winds of 110 mph (175 kph), making it a Category 2 hurricane. Simon has weakened since Saturday when it was a Category 4 system. "Simon is slowly losing wind intensity and could ultimately stall this week and never make a true landfall as an organized storm," said Alex DaSilva, a hurricane expert at private forecaster AccuWeather. Simon is forecast to make landfall on Thursday in Mexico's Sinaloa state. "The slower Simon moves, the more rain potential the storm carries, but right now most of that rain is offshore and to the south of the storm's center ultimately sparing the feet of rain we thought this storm could initially bring," said DaSilva. Simon was moving northwest at just 3 mph (6 kph) and was expected to continue along that track before turning northeast and moving inland across west-central Mexico around midweek. Authorities said that Simon could bring life-threatening flooding and mudslides to parts of the Pacific coast and nearby mountains. The hurricane is forecast to dump an additional 2 to 4 inches (5 to 10 cm) of rain across coastal areas of southwest and west-central Mexico, with isolated amounts of 6 to 8 inches (15 to 20 cm) in parts of Jalisco and Sinaloa. The National Hurricane Center said isolated storm totals could reach 30 inches (76 cm) in parts of Michoacan, Colima and Jalisco. The head of Mexico's civil protection agency, Laura Velazquez, said one person was reported to have died due to the storm in Guerrero state, home to the popular tourist destination of Acapulco. In the coastal town of Cihuatlan in southwestern Jalisco, patrols warned residents to prepare for potential evacuation as the Marabasco River rose. Floodwater inundated streets and low-lying areas of the town overnight. In the port city of Manzanillo in Colima state, residents waded through flooded homes and streets as navy personnel helped remove water. "Everything got flooded," said resident Maria Elena Vazquez from inside her home, pants rolled up as the water came up to her ankles. The National Hurricane Center said Simon was expected to produce dangerous storm surge and large destructive waves close to where it approaches the coast. Swells from the hurricane are also forecast to create life-threatening surf and rip current conditions along southwestern and west-central Mexico over the next few days. Following weeks of storms that have battered Mexico, at least 10 people are missing in the state of Baja California and one minor was killed in the coastal city of Ensenada.

LONDON, Oct 12 : Britain's AI Security Institute has been given access to the latest advanced AI models and is working with the US government and major developers, including Google, to assess their safety, AI Minister Kanishka Narayan said on Monday. Britain, which is not home to any major AI developers, is seeking a leading role in efforts to assess and manage the risks posed by increasingly powerful AI systems. Scrutiny of AI safety has intensified after developers including Anthropic and OpenAI disclosed instances of rogue or undesired behaviour by AI agents. Some industry figures have warned the technology could pose an existential threat to humanity. Monday's announcement, which did not specify all the models the institute is evaluating, comes after reports last month that the White House has asked OpenAI and Anthropic to withhold new models from British testers pending a US review.

"I can confirm that AI scientists at the AI Security Institute are now conducting rigorous evaluations of the latest generation of models, including Gemini 4 Argon, to identify risks early, to test robust safeguards, to help keep people safe," Narayan said. Under voluntary agreements with major AI developers, the institute receives access to models before deployment, allowing it to assess their capabilities and risks and contribute to emerging international safety standards. Microsoft President Brad Smith said in an interview published by the BBC on Monday that Britain was well placed to help lead work on AI safety guidelines. In a letter published in September, the AISI said Anthropic had made clear that no organisation outside the US had access to its Mythos 5.1 model. Asked about access to frontier AI systems — something ministers have never confirmed the institute had lost on a wider basis — Narayan said the government had a long-standing relationship with the US built on trust. "When you're reliant on someone else's technology, you have to be clear-eyed about the permanence of any outcome. But I'm very confident that, as a consequence of the conversations we've had, we will be able to test the latest generation of models," he said.

item.title: 米スタバ、チポトレ買収を否定
item.description: ［１２日 ロイター］ - 米コーヒーチェーン大手のスターバックスの広報担当者は１２日、メキシコ料理チェーンのチポト...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米スタバ、チポトレ買収を否定 10/12 22:36 配信

ワシントン州シアトルのスターバックスで2025年11月撮影　REUTERS/Matt Mills McKnight/File Photo

［１２日　ロイター］ - 米コーヒーチェーン大手のスターバックスの広報担当者は１２日、メキシコ料理チェーンのチポトレ・メキシカン・グリルを買収する計画はないと述べた。

寄り前取引でスターバックス株は約１％上昇した一方、チポトレは約２％下落した。

買収が実現していれば、年間売上高約５００億ドルの巨大外食企業が誕生し、インフレに見舞われた消費者の需要の不透明感や操業コストの上昇、利益への圧迫に対処しやすくなるとみられていた。

先週、英紙フィナンシャル・タイムズ（ＦＴ）は、スターバックスがここ数カ月、チポトレに対する買収提案の可能性を巡ってアドバイザーと協議してきたと報じていた。
